name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride
description:
Scottish people are mad about cycling and keen to provide exciting and fun rides.
Please see our ride descriptions below to give you options to join us.

eventSubgroups.name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
In Scottish summer we might not have leaders available for this ride. Pls try to ride at the Cat descriptions anyway. Come join some daft Scottish people passionate about Zwift cycling. We ride for an hour every Sunday morning on our weekly social Club ride. Often to exercise, sometimes just to sober up. We ride in various group. This is group C.

Although this is not really a race, it will in true Zwift tradition maybe get a bit spicy. This ride is not always led by members or our club, so we encourage anyone to join and test each other out with the average power numbers set for the group. 

When in place a leader and sweeper will try to keep the group together matching the reasonable effort at the front and encouraging others to help the sweeper with those at the back. We might do some wee tests or sprints or little races to the lamppost if we/you feel like it. Please chat via messaging, but we have a discord channel for you to use for the banter if you want. If for some reason you can’t make the start time, late joining is available up to 30mins post. 

Please use our "Sunday Club Ride" Discord voice channel here:  https://discord.com/channels/731107240987197461/1329849513313042463

eventSubgroups.name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
In Scottish summer we might not have leaders available for this ride. Pls try to ride at the Cat descriptions anyway. Come join some daft Scottish people passionate about Zwift cycling. We ride for an hour every Sunday morning on our weekly social Club ride. Often to exercise, sometimes just to sober up. We ride in various group. This is group D.

It’s a group ride so it’s not a race.  All abilities are welcome, but we’ll be tootling along at between 1.5 to 2.2. That’s where the banners will be but if you fancy shooting ahead on the day you are very welcome. You might miss the craic, but you won’t get removed. We might do some wee tests or sprints or little races to the lamppost if we/you feel like it. If you’re way ahead by then you might miss something fun. 

The leader and sweeper will try to keep the group together matching the reasonable effort at the front and encouraging others to help the sweeper with those at the back. We will chat via messaging, but we have a discord channel for you to use for the banter if you want. If for some reason you can’t make the start time, late joining is available up to 30mins post. 

Please use our "Sunday Club Ride" Discord voice channel here: https://discord.com/channels/731107240987197461/1329850433962770657

eventSubgroups.name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride (E)
eventSubgroups.description:
In Scottish summer we might not have leaders available for this ride. Pls try to ride at the Cat descriptions anyway. Come join some daft Scottish people passionate about Zwift cycling. We ride for an
hour every Sunday morning on our weekly social Club ride - often to exercise,
sometimes just to sober up. 

Group E is a very steady group ride, no way is it a race.  We’re here to encourage
beginners and recovering riders to come ride in a group. We’ll be going at between
1.0 and 1.5 watts/kilo, it’s no drop. 

The Lead and Sweep banners will riding around these power levels but if you want to go on ahead you are welcome, you might miss the chat and the socialising.  You won’t get removed by riding through the red fence of doom. We might add in some sprints or hill climbs but we will try to re-establish the blob when these are over.  If you fall behind, the sweep or helper will try to drop back to offer a wheel with the intention of trying to help you rejoin the main group or just to keep you company if that’s what you want.

The leader and sweeper will try to keep the group together matching the reasonable
effort at the front and encouraging others to help the sweeper with those at the back.

Please use our "Sunday Club Ride" Discord voice channel here https://discord.com/channels/731107240987197461/1329849787687764079

name: SISU Women's Punainen - Stage 3
description:
SISU Racing launches its boldest challenge yet: SISU Punainen, a Vuelta-inspired, seven-stage race series built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Set entirely in Watopia, this inaugural edition is unapologetically brutal, beautifully relentless, and designed for the mountain goats of the virtual peloton.

Riders will compete for three individual classifications, ensuring every stage offers something to race for. The coveted Punainen (red in FInnish) Jersey rewards the overall General Classification leader based on cumulative elapsed time across all seven stages. The Sprintteri Jersey recognises the fastest riders through the designated sprint segments, while the Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) Jersey celebrates the strongest climbers.  Whether you're an all-rounder, a sprinter or a pure climber, there's a jersey to chase.
Just like the Vuelta, SISU Punainen rewards courage, consistency, and climbing prowess.

For more information, and results, visit sisu.racing/punainen.

The Stages

Stage 1
Hilly Route, Watopia (Individual Time Trial)
Sat 22 & Sun 23 August

Stage 2
Mayan San Remo, Watopia
Tue 25 & Wed 26 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 3
Three Little Sisters, Watopia
Sat 29 & Sun 30 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 4
Climbers Gambit, Watopia
Tue 1 & Wed 2 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 5
Big Loop, Watopia
Sat 5 & Sun 6 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 6
Mountain 8, Watopia
Tue 8 & Wed 9 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 7
Mountain Route, Watopia
Sat 12 & Sun 13 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather, Aero or Anvil


Zwift Race Score

In our ongoing effort to keep the racing scene fresh and competitive, the upcoming SISU Punainen series is embracing Zwift's flexible new Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) framework!
Following a format similar to the recent Zwift Tour Fever series, this shift away from standard Category boundaries allows us to create tighter, more closely matched fields.

What this means for you:

A Shakeup in the Pack: If you usually find yourself stuck in the middle of a traditional category, this is your chance to step up, animate the race, and battle for the win.
New Challenges for Front-Runners: Former category leaders will be pushed to find new limits against a freshly recalibrated field.
Dynamic Racing Throughout: While the elite action in A Grade will remain as fierce as ever, expect highly competitive, unpredictable, and dynamic racing across the board - especially in Cat D Grade and expanded E Grade!

A Grade: 701-1000
B Grade: 551-700
C Grade: 401-550
D Grade: 251-400
E Grade: 1-250

The Jerseys

The General Classification (GC) is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages. The Team Classification is based on the combined time of each team's fastest three riders on every stage.
The Sprintteri and Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) classifications are determined by a rider's cumulative time through all designated Sprint and KOM/QOM segments of Stages 2 to 7. Where a stage includes the same segment multiple times, only the rider's fastest time through that segment will count toward the classification.

The Johtaja (leader in Finnish) classification is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages in each age category.

Upgrade Information

Riders who upgrade during the first six stages will be classified in their higher grade.  Riders who upgrade in Stage 7 will not be re-classified.

Further Information

Open events using Zwift’s Racing Score with separate results for Men and Women.
Each event is a mass start with all riders visible on the course.
TT bikes are mandatory for the iTT. Draft will be disabled.
Z Power and riders without heart rate data will be excluded from the results.
A rider's best time will count if they race the same stage in multiple zones.
To be included in the GC riders must have a Zwiftpower profile.
Team GC will be based on each team’s fastest three riders.

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+

WOMEN'S EVENTS = Dedicated women's races available throughout the series.

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:

Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: GXY LUNA - LADIES ONLY ENDURANCE RIDE [1.6-2.0 W/KG] CAT D
description:
Welcome to GXY LUNA our ladies only group endurance ride!

The ethos of this ride is social and inclusive. The pace will be 1.6-2.0 w/kg with the yellow beacon leader expecting to complete the ride in the middle of that range.

Although there may not always be a red beacon, we have some strong female riders who are happy to help anyone who is struggling with the power or who has fallen off the back to return to the group.

Ride duration will vary between 60-100 minutes to allow for a variety of routes and occasional badge hunting. Depending on the course, there may be opportunity to sprint or climb but please respect the leader's pace as we have an active "hot" fence to help keep us cosy and the draft strong. All ladies are welcome! However, we are looking to be especially encouraging to ladies who are newer to Zwift, those trying to boost their fitness and endurance, or wanting to learn how to get more from their training.

Alongside the onscreen chat during the ride, please join us on Discord (ladies public social channel) where we hope to
connect, build friendships and support each other. You can bring your questions for our experienced leaders and team
riders, plus discuss issues relating to ladies Zwifting, fitness and general health.

GXY are a friendly inclusive and supportive club who strive to help others succeed. We are looking forward to riding
with you today.

If you want to become a member and join our community to race, ride socially, or both, please come and join ideally
via our Facebook link below:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/galaxycyclingclub/
https://www.strava.com/clubs/989894
https://www.instagram.com/galaxycyclingclub

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: VirtuSlo 4Endurance Race
description:
Welcome to our VirtuSlo 4Endurance Race. 
The Rules are simple: finish as fast as possible and have Fun!


PEN -> Zwift Racing Score
Pen A / 700 - 1000
Pen B / 570 - 700
Pen C / 460 - 570
Pen D / 350 - 460
Pen E / 0 - 350

RULES AND RACE Settings
- No Powerups
- No TT Bikes
- Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results
- Smart trainer or Power Meter required.
- Heart Rate Monitor required.
- No Indoor Bikes without Controlled Resistance (Cadence=Power)
- Sticky Watts or unusual pedalling technique to get an unrealistic advantage will result in DQ

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
- Zwift Activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.
- Elite Level Performances above the limits stated below must be supported by DUAL POWER Recordings uploaded to Zwiftpower and with margin off error of less than 4%. Outside KOM efforts on Strava can be used for verification of Dual Power analysis.
*MEN: above 4.8W/kg or 350W for 20min, 5.5W/kg or 425W for 5min, 9W/kg for 1min.
**WOMEN: above 4.5W/kg or 280W for 20min, 5W/kg or 325w for 5min, 7.5W/kg for 1min.

WHAT IS ZWIFTPOWER?
For further information on connecting to ZwiftPower, check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Zwiftpower results: questions, complaints, etc., please contact us https://virtuslo.cc/

description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Series Schedule

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

https://flammerougeracing.com/

- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.

name: DIRT The Merge powered by Formula 369
description:
Welcome to endurance central, it’s time to take your riding to the next level. The Merge powered by Formula 369 is a true endurance long ride. The group is looking to keep steady power pacing and work together to keep pressure on the pedals while we enjoy friendly DIRT chat and social nature. All are welcome, no discrimination, and friendly.

This is NOT a race chase. The D group departs first, then C, and finally B, all riding at advertised pace. This will NATURALLY create a merge/meeting of groups. When groups meet, riders choose to stay with their group and leader or merge with the faster group. Similarly, faster group riders can stay with the slower group. Riders choice.

The group leaders help maintain group cohesion, listen up for their guidance.

A couple other notes:

-30 min late join.

-Sweeps will be organized as needed.

-Climb pace will be announced by the group leader and is designed to keep the group stay together. If you want to work harder, then pull the group on the flats. The group leader and group will NOT chase those doing more than the decided climb pace.

-This ride is designed to keep you in a narrow power band, for true endurance training. This ride is NOT about climbing hard and sitting in on flats and downs.

-Being a nice human is always first priority.

-Those who train together become family. This family works together, supports each other, and cares about each other.

-Those planning to ride an average in the middle of the groups are encouraged to pick a group and stay on pace. Both groups can be pulled on the flats but spreading the group out on climbs or false flats is not appreciated. Those riding 3-3.4 can practice drafting skills with B group.

name: CRYO-GEN TSS: The Sunday Session
description:
Kick off your Sunday with a purposeful, two-hour structured burn. The Sunday Session (TSS) is designed for the rider looking to build a massive aerobic engine. We aren’t here to sprint or chase jerseys; we’re here to do the work that makes you an endurance powerhouse on the road.

The Mission
This session focuses on aerobic conditioning. By maintaining a steady and controlled output for 120 minutes or more, we trigger the adaptations necessary to improve our endurance, durability, and fatigue resistance.

The Workout Structure
This is a banded group workout. As long as you keep pedaling, the "rubber band" effect will keep us together regardless of your power output. This event utilizes ERG mode, so your trainer will automatically adjust resistance to hit the target power for each interval. Intervals may feel challenging, even exceeding your estimated functional threshold power (FTP). CRYO-GEN TSS is open to riders of all levels. Embrace the challenge and push yourself to complete the session at the specified power. Your effort will pay off!

Join the Conversation
Use the Zwift Companion App or your keyboard to chat with the group. Share your goals for the upcoming week, discuss your favorite ride snacks, or just enjoy the scenery as we clock hours in the saddle together. See you on the virtual road!

name: DIRT Xtra Long Ride
description:
Please join us weekly on Sunday mornings for a 2 hour endurance group ride. 

C cat pace 2.5 - 3.0 w/kg  

Our yellow beacon will ride steady in C cat at 2.5-3.0 w/kg and in D cat at 1.5-2.0 w/kg for the entirety of the ride. On the hills we will not exceed the upper end of these ranges.

This is a social group ride. All are welcome to join. Please follow the yellow beacon at all times.

Team DIRT is an acronym for Dads Inside Riding Trainers. We started as a group of dads who all ride regularly before or after work. We are a social racing team consisting of all zwift levels. 

Don't forget to add "DIRT" after your name and make sure you are not on a TT bike.

Please join us on Discord at https://discord.gg/sUnwqPZ

name: FRR Sunday Drive
description:
"Flamme Rouge Racing Sunday Drive - is this a race ... if you want but equally group up and enjoy the burn.... Different route each week, 90mins to 2hrs

Ride leads may vary each week and when the Tours are on Race Control will certainly be racing... but enjoy them after all it's your time...

If you fancy the hardest but most rewarding Tour on Zwift with great support then come register at 
https://www.flammerougeracing.com/?page=home

Tour of France (21 – 29th October) - Completed
Tour Britannia (25th November - 3 December) - 8 Stages in 9 days
Tour Watopia (2nd – 10th January) - 8 Stages in 9 days
World Tour (17 Feb - 10 March) - 21 Stages 3 weeks full Tour length
World Championship - Apil 12 - 1 Stage 1 time globally

The event Incorporates a mixture of flat, hilly and mountain courses, increasing the intensity as the Tour progresses using a mix of iTT and POINTS races.

EVENT PENs are via autocat and will release at the same time
All riders will see and be able to communicate to each other in race - separatign the most powerful riders is expected to provide more appropriate race starts for every class of rider

Communication

Discord - Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything on the Tour

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Facebook FRR Event Group - A place where we share intentions and thought for community input before we do stuff

So be SMART and use SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anythung more will be removed and warnings will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: 6Points Challenges Group Sunday Training Ride
description:
This is a TRAINING event, category C, with a yellow beacon leader. The beacon leader will ride up to a 2.5w/kg pace average wherever possible. The beacon may employ the fence at times.

Please look out for this training ride on Sundays, every week, at 11.40am UTC in the UK, 6.40am EDT in the US, and at 12.40 CET in Europe. Use #6Points to search for our rides on the Zwift website.

This weekly 6Points Mallorca Sunday training ride is intended to provide a challenge for riders, and is open to all timezones. You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the beacon ride leader(s) for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. All our group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the beacon. The fence may be used to control starts for these spicy sections. About the in-real-life Reverence 6Points Mallorca
The ultra-distance Reverence 6Points Mallorca real life cycling event, with Title sponsor Reverence Hotels, is ridden around Mallorca and raises money for charity, currently supporting Asdica, who work on behalf of disabled children, and Save-the-Med. Now in its third edition, it has already earned a reputation as a fun but tough event that epitomises cycling at its best. 6Points has raised over €100,000 for charities in this way over three years.

6Points is a ride around the whole of the beautiful island of Mallorca, covering well over 420 kms, climbing 7500 metres and touching the four compass extremities, as well as the highest and lowest points of Mallorca, over 3 days. See https://6pointschallenges.com/ for more about our in-real-life events. We also run these events in Ibiza / Formentera and Menorca.

Like our Zwift group ride, 6Points Mallorca is NOT a race. It is an opportunity to participate in a challenging ride, with like-minded cyclists, to enjoy Mallorca’s diverse beauty and the friendship and camaraderie of fellow riders. 6Points supports sustainable cycling, whose riders care for the environment and practise courtesy to fellow road users.

We have organized our 6Points Zwift training ride series to suit what we believe is relevant to bike riders’ interests in performance and improvement, bearing in mind the in-real-life 6Points Mallorca challenge which is also ridden in groups with controlled pace.

The 6Points Zwift group ride
As we expect our riders to be able to ride up to 100 miles at or around a 15mph average on our irl (in-real-life) rides, such steady riding members should be comfortable with Zwift Category C. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift message (always) and/or Discord (sometimes) to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals and optionally a mini-race towards the end of the rides, with regrouping after each sprint. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and rest intervals.

During the ride, the beacon will announce any sprints, and the ride will finish with a minirace to the end of the ride of between 3kms and 8kms depending on the course. The Beacon will announce this too.

Results (the finishing order, relevant to the minirace which we will all start together) can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we will, in common with many other ride series, publish your results on zwiftpower.com too, based on the ride category C.

All bikes and Power-Ups (PU) are allowed, but it is better not to use TT bikes to ensure drafting. Please add 6Points (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognized, where X is your own ride category. Categories in Zwift are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg to get the W/kg that applies to you.

On this ride series, all riders and categories are welcome, but bear in mind that rides are designed for:

Category C: 2 W/kg to 3 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average or below.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart rate monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.

You can use our Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/bPsQCNh

Please see the 6Points Zwift page link at https://6pointschallenges.com for more, including how we support our chosen charities.

https://6pointschallenges.com/

#6points

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: ZZRC Wind Down Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Wind Down Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

description:

name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
Everyone is welcome to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round in our Sunday social ride.
Our social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubberband so
we can be one big, joyful bunch cruising the roads where everyone belongs. No
surges, no stress, no getting left behind.
If the leader isn’t using the rubberband, they will let you know, but they’ll aim to
maintain a social pace. You can check the event details to see if this is the case for
this ride by using the link 'Toggle Event Details' at the end of the event description on
zwift.com.
Ride leaders may have quizzes or other fun stuff planned for you, so please do get
involved using the companion app chat function.
Our rides are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always
respectful. Ride chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open
heart and open mind. If you want to enjoy a relaxed ride with an amazing community,
this is your space. Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.
If you want to learn more about what to expect on one of our rides, or find links to our
Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: Into the Red Race by RELENTLESS
description:
Into the Red Race by RELENTLESS

WHAT IS CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT?
Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for. Our goal is to increase fairness in racing while promoting a fun environment.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
The race will be mass start and allow all racers to push themselves to the next level.  Each race will change routes and worlds each week but will always be 25 km.  These “different” race finishes will require tactics and planning to know when and where to play your move.

You must be opted-in on Zwift.com & ZwiftPower.com to be counted for race results.
We highly encourage A racers to follow Zwift eRacing Ruleset.

Dual recording of trainer & power meter, and recent weigh-in based on Zwift Transparency rules recommended–we reserve the right to ask for this information to verify outstanding performances.

name: ODZentury Endurance Builder Ride
description:
Come join Team ODZ every Sunday morning for an Endurance Skill building ride.

Emphasis will be on teamwork and building endurance fitness as a group throughout the winter.

name: The HERD Sunday Endurance
description:
Welcome to the Herd’s Sunday Endurance Ride.

This is not a race, but a long ride at a steady pace with a big group. We ride together for two hours at a pace of 1.5 w/kg on the flats and 2.0 w/kg on climbs.

All riders are welcome and appreciated. Whether you’re brand-new to Zwift or have been on the platform for a decade, we want to ride with you.

Routes change weekly and we ask that you please follow the ride leader’s instructions. The ride leader can turn on the fence if needed to control the pace, but we are always better working as a team. Please respect the leader's pace and stay with the yellow beacon.

Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back, rather than flying off the front. And if you fall off the pace give a shout and someone will fall back to help bring you back to the group.

name: HerD Beginner Races
description:
Where do you go to try racing or to grow a little better with your racing craft… Herd Beginner Races is set up to provide you with that opportunity by using Zwift Racing Scores (ZRS) with bandwidths that are set up so you’re competing with people of similarities and routes that enable you to challenge yourself and grow with racing. Our pens are set up so you're racing with others of similar abilities. Zwift will recommend your pen in blue; you can race in a higher up pen but it's not recommended.

Each week HBR races will have a different focus; racing on a flat route, rolling/undulating with a small climbs, and a route that is commonly used in many Zwift racing events. In addition, the last race of the month will be Tick-Tock so that you can monitor your performance.

name: RO4H Sunday Social Spin
description:
Welcome to the RO4H Sunday Social Spin!
The RO4H Sunday Social Spin is a friendly, supportive group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community. We aim to create a casual, respectful atmosphere that welcomes everyone—from seasoned Zwifters to first‑time group ride participants.
Pace & Expectations
Our overall average pace is typically 18–20 MPH (28–32 KPH). Terrain will naturally influence speed:
- Flats may run slightly faster within the peloton
- Climbs will remain sub‑2 W/kg
- Routes are usually flat, and we strive to be a no‑drop ride
This pace is recovery for some and a solid effort for others, so riders should be prepared to meet the average and stay with the leader’s peloton to enjoy the draft. This is a social ride, not a race—we don’t chase flyers, and flyers are free to fly.
Sweep Support
Sweepers are on hand to help anyone who drifts off the back. Their goal is to ensure no one rides alone unless they prefer to. They may help riders bridge back to the peloton or form a second pace group for a more comfortable experience.
Join the Fun
Come along for the RO4H Sunday Social Spin—you’ll likely break a sweat, hear a few dad jokes, and definitely have some fun. Welcome to the RO4H family!

eventSubgroups.name: RO4H Sunday Social Spin (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to the RO4H Sunday Social Spin. 

The RO4H Sunday Social Spin is a social group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community where a friendly, casual, supportive, and respectful atmosphere embraces everyone from the most seasoned Zwifter to the first-time group ride participant.   

The pace varies depending on terrain but will have an overall average pace of about 18-20 MPH/28-32 KPH for the ride. The pace on the flats sections will be slightly faster in the peloton and will remain sub 2 W/KG on climbs. We typically ride flat routes and try to be a no-drop ride but ultimately this pace is a recovery pace for some and a great effort for others. You should be prepared to meet the average pace and strive to stay in the ride leaders peloton to benefit from the group draft effect.  Being a social ride, we don’t chase flyers — flyers are free to fly — and this ride is certainly not a race (#zwiftisalwaysarace). 

Sweepers are available to assist those off the back. We do not want anyone to ride alone unless they choose. The sweepers will variably help riders bridge to the peloton or form a second pace group so riders do not ride alone.  

So come along for the RO4H Social Spin — you'll almost certainly break a sweat, undoubtedly hear a few dad jokes, and might even have some fun.

name: Ascend Together - A Zwift Climbing Adventure
description:

Each week, we’ll tackle a fresh climbing challenge on Zwift, rotating routes to keep the adventure alive and spirits high. Some weeks, we'll even target special Route Badges — perfect for those climbs that seem a little too daunting when tackled solo.

This ride is open to everyone in the Zwift community because, frankly, we love your company. Expect a steady pace around 2.5 w/kg, designed to keep the group together and the energy strong. No matter your club, team, or solo status, we welcome you to make Ascend Together part of your weekly schedule. Let’s create a ride to remember — every single week. See you on the climb!

name: WOW - High Speed Ride on TT bikes with draft
description:
The WOW Zwift events are the fastest way to collect happy miles while meeting exceptional riders/ friends on ZWIFT. While you will be assigned a fast TT bike with the latest DT Swiss Disc wheel set in draft mode, you will still be upgrading your bike of choice selected in your garage before starting the ride.

Our Ds (Development of ‘Drecovery’ 😊) leave the pen first and hold the group together within D power limits. Several minutes later C’s (Crusaders) will start and keep riding as one unit guided by the power range. Further several minutes later the B train (Bombers) starts unleashing their watts. Several minutes later the A magician group (Aliens) take off and rapidly make up the delays from the groups starting ahead. When will the groups catch each other? Every catch will be an opportunity to celebrate the ONE WOW FAMILY!

All groups will see each other, transfers between the groups on the go will be possible. The ride leaders will help make those transitions smooth.

WOW is a no drama, full fun ride!

Double draft is on and the fast TT bikes will be drafting!

name: The Zwifty Fifty with DZR
description:
**The Zwifty Fifty: When 25 is Too Little and 100 is Too Much**

DZR brings to you the Goldilocks of Zwift racing intensity and endurance balance. With weekly races at about 50 km, the races are not too short and intensive to build stamina, and not too long and time-consuming to actually get done. They are just right. And they are on every Sunday at 14:45 CET | 8:45 AM EST.

To add to the fun and keep a high intensity throughout the race, we have included bonus second sprints. These sprints are on flats when the finish is on a KOM and on KOMs when the finish is flat.

No powerups, no zpower, no TT bikes, HRM enforced.

For all the details, including stage information, bonus sprints, rules, and registration links, visit the official website for The Zwifty Fifty at http://dzrracingseries.com/the-zwifty-fifty/

We will try to keep the groups pace around 2.0-2.5 w/kg, also we ride 20 or more miles depends on the route. The ride is banded to keep everyone together and the stronger riders can help pull us along!

Rules

- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform

name: SISU Punainen - Stage 3
description:
SISU Racing launches its boldest challenge yet: SISU Punainen, a Vuelta-inspired, seven-stage race series built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Set entirely in Watopia, this inaugural edition is unapologetically brutal, beautifully relentless, and designed for the mountain goats of the virtual peloton.

Riders will compete for three individual classifications, ensuring every stage offers something to race for. The coveted Punainen (red in FInnish) Jersey rewards the overall General Classification leader based on cumulative elapsed time across all seven stages. The Sprintteri Jersey recognises the fastest riders through the designated sprint segments, while the Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) Jersey celebrates the strongest climbers.  Whether you're an all-rounder, a sprinter or a pure climber, there's a jersey to chase.
Just like the Vuelta, SISU Punainen rewards courage, consistency, and climbing prowess.

For more information, and results, visit sisu.racing/punainen.

The Stages

Stage 1
Hilly Route, Watopia (Individual Time Trial)
Sat 22 & Sun 23 August

Stage 2
Mayan San Remo, Watopia
Tue 25 & Wed 26 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 3
Three Little Sisters, Watopia
Sat 29 & Sun 30 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 4
Climbers Gambit, Watopia
Tue 1 & Wed 2 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 5
Big Loop, Watopia
Sat 5 & Sun 6 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 6
Mountain 8, Watopia
Tue 8 & Wed 9 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 7
Mountain Route, Watopia
Sat 12 & Sun 13 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather, Aero or Anvil


Zwift Race Score

In our ongoing effort to keep the racing scene fresh and competitive, the upcoming SISU Punainen series is embracing Zwift's flexible new Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) framework!
Following a format similar to the recent Zwift Tour Fever series, this shift away from standard Category boundaries allows us to create tighter, more closely matched fields.

What this means for you:

A Shakeup in the Pack: If you usually find yourself stuck in the middle of a traditional category, this is your chance to step up, animate the race, and battle for the win.
New Challenges for Front-Runners: Former category leaders will be pushed to find new limits against a freshly recalibrated field.
Dynamic Racing Throughout: While the elite action in A Grade will remain as fierce as ever, expect highly competitive, unpredictable, and dynamic racing across the board - especially in Cat D Grade and expanded E Grade!

A Grade: 701-1000
B Grade: 551-700
C Grade: 401-550
D Grade: 251-400
E Grade: 1-250

The Jerseys

The General Classification (GC) is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages. The Team Classification is based on the combined time of each team's fastest three riders on every stage.
The Sprintteri and Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) classifications are determined by a rider's cumulative time through all designated Sprint and KOM/QOM segments of Stages 2 to 7. Where a stage includes the same segment multiple times, only the rider's fastest time through that segment will count toward the classification.

The Johtaja (leader in Finnish) classification is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages in each age category.

Upgrade Information

Riders who upgrade during the first six stages will be classified in their higher grade.  Riders who upgrade in Stage 7 will not be re-classified.

Further Information

Open events using Zwift’s Racing Score with separate results for Men and Women.
Each event is a mass start with all riders visible on the course.
TT bikes are mandatory for the iTT. Draft will be disabled.
Z Power and riders without heart rate data will be excluded from the results.
A rider's best time will count if they race the same stage in multiple zones.
To be included in the GC riders must have a Zwiftpower profile.
Team GC will be based on each team’s fastest three riders.

name: Bike MS - Banded Badge Hunt
description:
Multiple Sclerosis does not stop, so neither will we as we ride together for this great cause. Bike MS is excited to offer another series of rides to keep cyclists connected year round with hopes of also connecting at one of the many Bike MS Events across the US in person. The Rubberband effect will be on during the ride to help keep cyclists of all abilities together as we explore some of the longer and more difficult routes throughout the many worlds of Zwift. 
Whatever pace you ride we welcome you to come join a group of passionate cyclists looking to raise funds and awareness for those living with multiple sclerosis. We hope you enjoy the ride and if so, please join Bike MS Zwift Club for year round training and community engagement. Come for the miles of smiles and stay for the XP. 
Bike MS is the largest charity cycling series across the United States consisting of 50 rides and raising over $50 million in 2023 for the National MS Society. Bike MS supports the National MS Society's mission to Cure MS while empowering all people affected by MS to live their best lives. Whether you want to cross the Finish Line in person or take on a new challenge from anywhere — there’s a Bike MS event that’s right for you! 
Check out www.bikeMS.org and experience the ride of your life. Use Zwift25 for a discount on your Bike MS Ride entry fee.
Come join us for weekly Club Rides: Bike MS ZC
#dontjustride #bikeMS #whateverittakes #strongertogether

name: Phoenix Rising Tronathon (Banded)
description:
Tronathon is a social, supportive banded ride. We help riders build strength, endurance and comfort in riding hills. We also mix in a healthy amount of entertainment and distraction. Tronathon was established in 2020 to help riders earn their Tron bike while also earning the Avid or Masochist badges. This continues to be our goal. All are welcome whether you are a newer cyclist, question if you can reach the summit of one of Zwift's hills, currently hate climbing, or just want to support other riders. Everyone has a story about their first Alpe, Tron quest or the climbing gains they've made and we want to hear yours. We are a fun loving community and welcome all who might want to join us!

For more information on all our weekly events, join our club Phoenix Rising on Zwift Companion.

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/mNMva8ekJR

name: ZZRC Sunday Cruise Control
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Cruise Control 2-2.5. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2-2.5 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised.

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app.

name: Catrina's Ladies Social Ride
description:
I would like to invite ALL women to join this Social Ride & Social exchange! Our goals during the ride are as follows:

1. Recovery from Training
2. Socialization with other women riders (via Catrina’s Social Ride channel or Group Texting in Zwift)
3. Support, Development, & Growth toward becoming better cyclists/athletes in a nurturing group setting
4. Teaching skills in the Zwift program course (Riding in Groups, Draft Effect, Racing Technique, Rolling Cadence, etc.)
5. To have FUN!

This is a Social Ride, with a goal of keeping everyone together, in order to build on group riding skills. This ride is not a "race", although we may practice racing techniques. At all times, we will try to have 1-2 Ladies on the ride to assist the women on the course. Some weeks will be in workout mode but always at z2 efforts. If you yearn for opportunities to meet & socialize with other women cyclists who are passionate about riding, we strongly encourage you to join us!

Ultimately our goal is to enhance your riding experience, while having FUN!

name: Turbocharged Sunday Social
description:
Join several of the Turbo riders for this Turbocharged Sunday Social group ride aka TSS, because who doesn’t love a little TSS!?  

Come for the banter, stay for the after party.  Each week will be a 2.5 hour rubber band group ride, meaning you can go whatever pace you’d like and we all stay together.  Each week we will be on a route in Watopia and after the event ends, anyone that wants to go party pace, we will be headed to Epic Forward KOM for a spirited pace to the top!

name: Group Run 5k
description:
DESCRIPTION

Join us for a 5k group run.   It's run-at-your-own-pace and all are welcome! 

Pick the closest pace group for you, but all groups will start together and you are free to fall back and run ahead. The pace groups designate average pace for the duration of the run. Most groups will start slower and finish faster than the indicated pace. Feel free to mix in some intervals and race your friends.

Join us for an exhilarating 3R Group Ride Event, where teamwork isn’t just encouraged, it’s essential!

This description does not include the C endurance ride, this is as usual a normal C endurance ride.

In this Chase Endurance Ride, we embark on a 100km journey, following the same course as our Steady State B group. The aim? To gradually close the gap and merge with the Steady State B Group around the 80km mark, setting the stage for an exciting final stretch.

This ride is about group effort and shared responsibility. We expect each rider to contribute, taking turns on the front with pulls of approximately 4.5-5.0 w/kg. Remember, it’s a chase, not a free ride, so we kindly ask that you join in the spirit of collective effort rather than just drafting throughout.

When our group catches up with the Steady State B group, it’s a chance to mix things up! If you’re feeling strong, keep up the pace with the A group. Alternatively, if you’re in the mood for a more relaxed ride, feel free to settle in with the B group.

Remember, this isn’t a race, but a part of our #ProStyleTraining series, designed to support your training goals in a fun, social setting. We love a bit of friendly banter and encourage you to share your experiences and feedback on our Facebook page at https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/. Let’s ride, raise, race and enjoy together with #Team3R.

name: The Mountain Massif
description:
Every great race has a defining climb.

This event is built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Expect a demanding route featuring sustained ascents, decisive hills, and relentless terrain that rewards patience, tactical awareness, and exceptional endurance.

The strongest rider doesn’t always win—but the smartest one often does.

Conserve your energy in the wheels. Read the race. Cover the moves that matter. Then, when the gradient bites and your rivals begin to fade, commit without hesitation.

The decisive attack will come. The question is whether you’ll be the one launching it—or chasing it.

There are no easy kilometres here. Every climb is an opportunity to gain time. Every descent is a chance to recover. Every decision shapes the final result.

When the summit is in sight, hesitation is the difference between victory and watching the podium ride away.

Race with discipline. Climb with conviction. Finish with nothing left to give.

Rules:
Heart Rate monitor required and Zwift Power for official results.

More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
Everyone is welcome to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round in our Sunday social ride.
Our social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubberband so
we can be one big, joyful bunch cruising the roads where everyone belongs. No
surges, no stress, no getting left behind.
If the leader isn’t using the rubberband, they will let you know, but they’ll aim to
maintain a social pace. You can check the event details to see if this is the case for
this ride by using the link 'Toggle Event Details' at the end of the event description on
zwift.com.
Ride leaders may have quizzes or other fun stuff planned for you, so please do get
involved using the companion app chat function.
Our rides are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always
respectful. Ride chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open
heart and open mind. If you want to enjoy a relaxed ride with an amazing community,
this is your space. Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.
If you want to learn more about what to expect on one of our rides, or find links to our
Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: Herd Summer Racing League
description:
Welcome to the Herd Summer Racing League (HSRL)

HSRL is a series of points races. The race format can be a little bit different week to week, but in
most of the races you score points for your time on each of the segments (FTS), versus the times
set by the other competitors. You also score bonus points for your finishing position in the race
versus your competitors in your category. Each week the race format, segments and points for
this race will be posted at the Herd Racing League facebook group and on the Herd Racing
discord channel.

General Classification

The points in each race are used to determine your ranking for the race. Your race rank
determines how many league points you receive, with the winner scoring 50 points, 2nd place
getting 49 and so on, down to 1 point for 50th place. Each week there are six different events to
choose from - choose whichever suits your schedule best.

Schedule

21-23 August: Scotland After Party - ITT + FTS
28-30 August: Innsbruckring (3 laps) - Points race FTS + FIN
4-6 September: Double Espresso - Points race FTS + FIN
11-13 September: Downtown Eruption - Scratch race
18-20 September: BRAEk-fast Crits & Grits - Points race FTS + FIN
25-27 September: Hot Laps - Points race FAL + FIN
2-4 October: Twilight Crit (6 laps) - Points race FTS + FIN
9-11 October: London Uprising - Points race FTS + FIN

Race rules:

1. Smarttrainer or powermeter required.
2. Cadence sensor required.
3. Heart rate monitor required.
4. No indoor bikes without controlled resistance (cadence=power).
5. Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results.
6. For elite level performances the race organiser can request additional data to verify the
performance.
7. For podium finishers in all categories: Zwift activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.

For more information please see our Facebook Group:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

name: FRR Weekend Warrior Series - SCRATCH
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: Seattle Baby Steps 1.0-1.3 w/kg
description:
Are you looking for a supportive beginner or recovery ride?  If so welcome to Seattle Baby Steps! This weekly ride will be paced at an average of 1.0-1.3 w/kg on the flats and is intended for riders who are newer, younger, older, and recovering from injuries.  This is an enjoyable and conversational social ride where your participation is encouraged.  Baby Steps' goal is to help you build strength and confidence to try the hundreds of advanced rides, races, and events that are available every week on Zwift.

We haven't jumped on to the Discord bandwagon yet but join us on our Facebook page at: Seattle Baby Steps - Weekly Zwift Group Ride to stay in touch with the group and to share your thoughts and ask Zwift and other cycling-related questions. https://www.facebook.com/search/top/?q=seattle%20baby%20steps%20-%20weekly%20zwift%20group%20ride

GROUP RIDE ETIQUETTE FOR NEWCOMERS

Please respect the ride leader's pace and instructions. This is not a race and the ride leader will not chase anyone riding off the front of the group. If you feel the need to stretch your legs, do so on the sprints and then prepare to regroup immediately afterward. Faster riders are encouraged to sweep in the back to assist less strong riders who may be struggling to rejoin the group after sprints and inclines. Sprinkle Ride Ons far and wide to encourage and delight your fellow riders! Join in on the conversation (on-screen text), but be mindful of the younger folks (i.e., children) who join the ride from time to time.

name: OTR Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time
description:
Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time is a group ride, race & interval training all rolled into one fun challenging event. Unique “race” scoring, where results in ZwiftPower are based on sum of segment times on a route with punchy climbs and/or sprints. Group rides together at ~2wkg, and ride leader provides guidance and lead-outs to smash a segment; then regroup, rinse & repeat. New route every week.

Multiple time slots on Fri-Sun, including Fri Atlantic, Sun APAC and Sun Americas/EMEA.
Riders need to join ZwiftPower.com to see their results as sum of segment times.

Event links: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/snapcracklepop
Weekly results (across all time slots): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=2656
In-ride conversation (“SCP Ride” channel): https://discord.gg/B52qdExaW2
Chat, banter and results: https://discord.gg/HNzvx98srF

Group ride with all cats together at ~2w/kg. Yellow beacon / ride leader (when present) will provide instructions for each segment, and drop the fence when it's time to punch/sprint. Fence is for guidance only (non-zapping).

Ride at a relaxed pace between the timed segments.
Work together to optimize draft for faster segment times.
Slow or stop with yellow beacon after each segment to regroup.

All categories start in a single pen.
Results split per WKG category in ZwiftPower.
No power ups, default drafting, no TT bikes.

One of our regular SCP routes is 3.5 laps of Innsbruckring, with 4x Leg Snappers plus 3x sprints (stopping to regroup on the kicker in between). The challenge is to achieve sub 4 mins for the sum of 7 segment times for cats A/B (that's 45 secs per snapper plus 20 secs per sprint), sub 5 mins for cat C, and sub 7 mins for cat D. Best time to beat is 3:33.
Historical results for Leg Snapper: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1322

name: Turbo Ten p/b HPRT - Race 10 of 10
description:
High Performance Racing Towels are proud to present - Turbo Ten!

On Sunday, take part in ten back to back races on the shortest routes in Zwift!

1 - Downtown Dolphin (2.03km)
2 - The Bel Lap (2.04km)
3 - Macaron (2.6km)
4 - Glasgow Crit Circuit (3.26km)
5 - Glasgow Reverse (4.21km)
6 - LaGuardia Loop (4.3km)
7 - Duchy Estate (4.7km)
8 - LaGuardia Loop Reverse (5.2km)
9 - Queen's Highway (5.6km)
10 - ZG25 Climb Champs (5km)

Riders are categorised into 5 groups using their Compound Score (NB: To calculate your compound score multiply your 90 day best 5 minute power watts by watts oer kilo, eg 200*2=400 if your best 5 minute power is 200w as a 100kg rider)

Category A: 1700 and above
Category B: 1200-1700
Category C: 900-1200
Category D: 600-900
Category E: 0-600

Riders will all start together, but you will be able to see which riders are in your category by the letter on their jersey.

Big Heads and Boost Power ups will be in action! Every rider will receive two boost power ups in the pen (which give you a 1 second boost of power). Use them wisely!

Riders must be using a Smart Trainer, Smart Bike or Power Meter and have a Heart Rate Monitor paired to join the events.

Overall standings are taken from your overall time across all the stages that you take part in, see the results here: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=3345

To keep up with latest events and news, please join the club here: https://www.zwift.com/clubs/389fbdf0-9cd7-4b42-8f76-4d1b6af240ae

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: USMeS Ridgeline Assault 2.5–5.0 w/kg
description:
Welcome to USMeS Ridgeline Assault...where Sundays are earned one climb at a time.
This is a climbing-focused ride built for riders who want sustained elevation, steady pressure, and the freedom to push hard when the road tilts up. Routes change week to week, but the mission stays the same...commit to the climb and see what you’ve got.

Pace: 2.5–5.0 w/kg (choose your effort)
Duration: 60 minutes
2 Yellow Beacons
⚡️ Lead Beacon - spicier pace off the front
⚡️ Secondary beacon — pacing the advertised effort
🚫 No fence — ride where it makes sense for you

Ride Format
• Climb heavy routes with sustained efforts on the ascents
• A focused, supportive environment where hard work is expected

Expectations
• Climbing is honest work.
• Respect all riders, ride your pace, and stay engaged.
• Every summit counts, and every effort adds up.

When the climbing is done, spin it out and recover with the Sunday Endurance Ride. The perfect way to reset after the assault.
Find your line. Hold it to the top.

#conqueringlimits
#challengeaccepted

name: REVO Social SUB2
description: Join us for a 1.5-2 w/kg paced ride on a flat course. Let's stick together using the banded group ride feature! This allows everyone to stay together and chat while still doing your own effort, whether that’s truly a SUB2 or you want to do some intervals along the way. Complete this ride and unlock our Revolution Velo kit! Hosted by Revolution Velo Racing, a Zwift team for women. To hear about our upcoming rides, check out our Facebook Fans page at https://www.facebook.com/groups/RevoFans/

eventSubgroups.name: REVO Social SUB2 (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
Join us for a 1.5-2 w/kg paced ride on a flat course. Let's stick together using the new banded group ride feature as a trial this week! We will not chase riders that go off the front, and the ride lead may use the fence to keep everyone together. If you're feeling strong, please use your abilities and drop back and help pull the slower riders back up to the pack if someone gets dropped.

Complete this ride and unlock our Revolution Velo kit! Hosted by Revolution Velo Racing, a Zwift team for women. To hear about our upcoming rides, check out our Facebook Fans page at https://www.facebook.com/groups/RevoFans/

#revo

name: Velos Bumper Chase Race
description:
'Bumper' races prepare horses for the biggest events, so why not cyclists? And the name 'Chase' means 'to hunt' in old French, so join Velos for our newest event: 'The Bumper' Chase Race! We change courses weekly to keep it fresh, some weeks flat & others hilly... something for every taste.

A chase-style race is loads of fun because you work with others in your CAT to try and stay ahead of the faster riders. Wait for your group’s horn to sound: Ds take off first, then staggered starts release the Cs, Bs, and As from their pens with increasingly harder efforts required. If the group behind catches you, try to work with them to the finish. Each CAT wears a different kit, making it easier to see the group you are working to catch. Chase races help you learn how to work WITH a team, since a tighter bunch means a faster group. You will master team racing skills and get stronger whilst having fun along the way: the winning formula for ALL Velos events!

Join us at teamvelos.co.uk

description:
New to Zwift, just a little out of shape or recovering from injury? This is the group ride for you! All are welcome to join The Herd on this supportive and social event.

Respect the leader's pace and ride with the yellow beacon. This is NOT A RACE! Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back.

#herd

name: Pride Run
description:
Join with members of the LGBTQ+ community as we stride with Pride! 

Runs are hosted by LGBTQ Zwifters Club and we invite you to join our weekly rainbow run! In some runs you will find a leader to make it social and help keep you motivated. If you are in training for a duathlon or triathlon, you can even join a Pride Ride before your run, since runs are scheduled 30 min after each Pride ride ends. Our runs are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always respectful. Social chat may involve LGBTQ+ topics so please come with an open heart and open mind. 

If you want to learn more about our Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: SISU Punainen - Stage 3
description:
SISU Racing launches its boldest challenge yet: SISU Punainen, a Vuelta-inspired, seven-stage race series built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Set entirely in Watopia, this inaugural edition is unapologetically brutal, beautifully relentless, and designed for the mountain goats of the virtual peloton.

Riders will compete for three individual classifications, ensuring every stage offers something to race for. The coveted Punainen (red in FInnish) Jersey rewards the overall General Classification leader based on cumulative elapsed time across all seven stages. The Sprintteri Jersey recognises the fastest riders through the designated sprint segments, while the Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) Jersey celebrates the strongest climbers.  Whether you're an all-rounder, a sprinter or a pure climber, there's a jersey to chase.
Just like the Vuelta, SISU Punainen rewards courage, consistency, and climbing prowess.

For more information, and results, visit sisu.racing/punainen.

The Stages

Stage 1
Hilly Route, Watopia (Individual Time Trial)
Sat 22 & Sun 23 August

Stage 2
Mayan San Remo, Watopia
Tue 25 & Wed 26 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 3
Three Little Sisters, Watopia
Sat 29 & Sun 30 August

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 4
Climbers Gambit, Watopia
Tue 1 & Wed 2 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 5
Big Loop, Watopia
Sat 5 & Sun 6 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 6
Mountain 8, Watopia
Tue 8 & Wed 9 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather or Aero

Stage 7
Mountain Route, Watopia
Sat 12 & Sun 13 September

PowerUps - Draft, Feather, Aero or Anvil


Zwift Race Score

In our ongoing effort to keep the racing scene fresh and competitive, the upcoming SISU Punainen series is embracing Zwift's flexible new Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) framework!
Following a format similar to the recent Zwift Tour Fever series, this shift away from standard Category boundaries allows us to create tighter, more closely matched fields.

What this means for you:

A Shakeup in the Pack: If you usually find yourself stuck in the middle of a traditional category, this is your chance to step up, animate the race, and battle for the win.
New Challenges for Front-Runners: Former category leaders will be pushed to find new limits against a freshly recalibrated field.
Dynamic Racing Throughout: While the elite action in A Grade will remain as fierce as ever, expect highly competitive, unpredictable, and dynamic racing across the board - especially in Cat D Grade and expanded E Grade!

A Grade: 701-1000
B Grade: 551-700
C Grade: 401-550
D Grade: 251-400
E Grade: 1-250

The Jerseys

The General Classification (GC) is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages. The Team Classification is based on the combined time of each team's fastest three riders on every stage.
The Sprintteri and Vuorikauris (Mountain Goat) classifications are determined by a rider's cumulative time through all designated Sprint and KOM/QOM segments of Stages 2 to 7. Where a stage includes the same segment multiple times, only the rider's fastest time through that segment will count toward the classification.

The Johtaja (leader in Finnish) classification is decided by the cumulative elapsed time taken to complete all seven stages in each age category.

Upgrade Information

Riders who upgrade during the first six stages will be classified in their higher grade.  Riders who upgrade in Stage 7 will not be re-classified.

Further Information

Open events using Zwift’s Racing Score with separate results for Men and Women.
Each event is a mass start with all riders visible on the course.
TT bikes are mandatory for the iTT. Draft will be disabled.
Z Power and riders without heart rate data will be excluded from the results.
A rider's best time will count if they race the same stage in multiple zones.
To be included in the GC riders must have a Zwiftpower profile.
Team GC will be based on each team’s fastest three riders.

Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724
WOMEN'S EVENTS = Dedicated women's races available throughout the series.

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter

Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Group Run 10k
description:
Join us for a 10k group run.   It's run-at-your-own-pace and all are welcome! 

Pick the closest pace group for you, but all groups will start together and you are free to fall back and run ahead. The pace groups designate average pace for the duration of the run. Most groups will start slower and finish faster than the indicated pace. Feel free to mix in some intervals and race your friends. #pbt

name: ZTPL Cycling Club Coffee Ride
description:
☀️Weszliśmy w sezon wiosenno-letni.☀️
Część naszych eventów zostaje w kalendarzu, ale może zdarzyć się tak że nie będzie na nich naszych liderów jazd.
Jeśli tak się zdarzy, gorąca prośba do Was o jazdę wg. założeń danego eventu.
Nasze eventy i liderzy ZTPL Cycling Club wrócą ponownie na jesień 2026.
Póki co RIDE ON i korzystajcie z pogody, a jeśli nie możecie to bawcie się dobrze podczas naszych eventów.

Zapraszamy na wspólny event z ZTPL Cycling Club. Pamiętajcie o wyborze właściwej grupy.
Z założenia nasze jazdy prowadzą liderzy, którzy pomagają trzymać peleton w ryzach. Jeśli podczas eventu zabraknie lidera, starajcie się trzymać tempo na które się umówiliśmy w momencie gdy dołączyliście do wybranej grupy. To od Was zależy jak będziecie się bawić 😊

Po ukończonym evencie, jeśli jechaliście z nami pierwszy raz, w Waszym wirtualnym garażu będzie czekała nasza teamowa koszulka!
◾️Grupa E jest grupą dla najbardziej początkujących. Tempo będzie dostojne 😊 i będzie oscylowało w okolicach 1.3-1.7 w/kg
◾️Grupa D jest grupą początkującą. Tempo jest spokojne, uczymy się jazdy w grupie, jest czas żeby porozmawiać. Tempo będzie nieco wyższe niż w grupie E w granicach 1.8-2.5 w/kg

◾️ Jeśli chcecie przejechać jazdę w tempie Coffee Ride wybierzcie o jedną grupę niżej niż sugeruje wam wasze FTP lub zwiftpower :)
◾️ Wartości podane w opisach dotyczą średniego tempa z CAŁEJ jazdy (nie uwzględniają interwałów, które mogą wystąpić podczas np. podjazdów)
◾️ PAMIĘTAJCIE że podczas jazd grupowych NIE UŻYWAMY ROWERÓW CZASOWYCH!
◾️ Starajcie się pilnować peletonu i nie zgubić koła, samemu bardzo trudno jest odrobić stratę.
◾️ Proszę słuchajcie poleceń lidera, które podczas jazdy wyświetlane są na środku ekranu.
◾️ Lider, który prowadzi grupę podświetlony jest na żółto.
◾️ Starajcie się jechać blisko lidera, starając się go nie wyprzedać i nie wyjeżdżać przed bramę, która informuje Was że jedziecie za szybko.

name: USMeS – Operational Reach – 2.2–>2.8 w/kg
description:
USMeS Operational Reach – 2.2 –> 2.8 w/kg

Welcome to USMeS – Operational Reach.  In military terms, operational reach is the distance and duration a unit can effectively operate before combat power starts to fade, and the supplies start running low. In cycling terms... how long can you keep the legs delivering before they start filing complaints? For the next 90 minutes, we are going to find out! 😈🌋😈  

This is a strong, spirited ride built around sustained work with plenty of opportunities to turn up the pressure.  The group sets the rhythm, but when the right segment appears, consider that permission to have a little fun.

✅ Ride average watts: 2.2–>2.8 w/kg
✅ Duration: 90 minutes

We push on the climbs and designated segments, so expect the pace to get spicy throughout the ride. Make your move, test the legs, then fall back in quickly. The hard efforts are part of the fun, but keeping the group moving together is always the priority.

Respect the leader. Respect the group.
Work together between the pushes and be ready when it's time to go.

Extend the range. Hold the effort. Complete the mission.

description:

name: VirtuSlo 4Endurance Race - Flat is Fast
description:
Welcome to our VirtuSlo 4Endurance Race. 
The Rules are simple: finish as fast as possible and have Fun!


PEN -> Zwift Racing Score
Pen A / 700 - 1000
Pen B / 570 - 700
Pen C / 460 - 570
Pen D / 350 - 460
Pen E / 0 - 350

RULES AND RACE Settings
- No Powerups
- No TT Bikes
- Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results
- Smart trainer or Power Meter required.
- Heart Rate Monitor required.
- No Indoor Bikes without Controlled Resistance (Cadence=Power)
- Sticky Watts or unusual pedalling technique to get an unrealistic advantage will result in DQ

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
- Zwift Activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.
- Elite Level Performances above the limits stated below must be supported by DUAL POWER Recordings uploaded to Zwiftpower and with margin off error of less than 4%. Outside KOM efforts on Strava can be used for verification of Dual Power analysis.
*MEN: above 4.8W/kg or 350W for 20min, 5.5W/kg or 425W for 5min, 9W/kg for 1min.
**WOMEN: above 4.5W/kg or 280W for 20min, 5W/kg or 325w for 5min, 7.5W/kg for 1min.

WHAT IS ZWIFTPOWER?

description:
Join Team Evolve for the EVOLVE 25, an electrifying 25km race on Zwift, utilizing the Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) system to match cyclists of all levels in a dynamic, community-driven virtual peloton.
