name: ZZRC Ride With Friends 1.3-1.5
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Ride With Friends 1.5. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.3-1.5. on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be 1.5

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/teHeHABDHc

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: TBR Power Up
description:
TBR Power Up is an hour long, all category friendly interval session. There are two intervals at approximately 2.5 watts/kg and one open watts interval.
We recover at our base pace of 1.8 wkg for 10 minutes between each interval.

We roll out at 1.8wkg to group up. Interval 1 is 7.5 minutes at 2.5 w/kg. Interval 2 is 10 minutes at 2.5w/kg. The final interval is The Wild Goose Race with no w/kg limit for 10 minutes to really test your mettle.

We don't use the fence for this ride as we believe all riders should exercise self-control and respect the ride leader by riding with the yellow beacon at all times. Your co-operation helps us provide everyone with a fun, supportive and inclusive ride.
Follow TBR at thebigring.cc to learn more about our events, read ride reports and leave feedback.

name: Team CLS Chill 'n' Spin Sunday Ride
description:
It’s time to join Team CLS for our Sunday Chill ‘n’ Spin ride… and UNLOCK our awesome Team CLS Kit.

Spin the legs and enjoy some banter. While stronger riders may choose to use this event as a recovery ride, this will also be an opportunity to get in a solid ride at mid D cat pace.

The focus is on riding with the bunch around the beacon as closely as possible. We see this ride as being a great event for riders that are:
- New to zwift, or have not tried a group ride before
- Recovering from injury
- Looking for a controlled group ride at D cat pace
- Easing back on the intensity and want a ride with plenty of chat.

Like all our events please make sure you can hold the above pace as we cannot reduce this at the expense of other riders although we will help to tow you back for dropouts etc.

WARNING - Please only attempt sneaky sprints on this ride if you feel your legs are sufficiently warmed up to do so. Sudden high intensity efforts on cold muscles is not advised.

description:
Where do you go to try racing or to grow a little better with your racing craft… Herd Beginner Races is set up to provide you with that opportunity by using Zwift Racing Scores (ZRS) with bandwidths that are set up so you’re competing with people of similarities and routes that enable you to challenge yourself and grow with racing. description:
Race the full Road to Sky route and finish with a climb up Zwift's most famous road, the Alpe Du Zwift. 

Race in pace categories A-D. 

This race is hosted by the Good Time Riders, GTR, an online bunch of friends from across the world who enjoy riding, racing hard, and generally having a good time together. Everyone is very welcome, you can find us on the Companion App, Facebook and Discord.

name: GardaBikeHotel Social Ride
description:
Welcome to Garda Bike Hotel social ride! We are a Bike Hotel on beautiful Lake Garda, Italy. We are specialized in cycling vacations and when here with us, our guests will experience the culture and beauty of our location, the breath taking riding routes, the local cuisine and the wine tasting. We also offer combined tours to other iconic cycling destinations including Stelvio, Dolomites, Piedmont, Adriatic Coast, Rome, Tuscany and Lake Como.

The aim of this inclusive Zwift ride is to have fun, be friendly and connect with our growing community around the world. All of our rides will be led by one of our friendly professional cycling guide. The route will change every week and we will try to keep the ride at around 2.0 watts per kg to make sure everyone can join in and enjoy the fun. We are an official PINARELLO rental centre and on our Zwift rides we will be riding a beautiful Pinarello Dogma F12!

To find out more about Garda Bike Hotel, please visit our website at https://www.gardabikehotel.com/en

Facebook: Garda Bike Hotel
Instagram: gardabikehotel

name: Know No Bounds Ride
description:
Welcome to the #KnowNoBounds Ride! A ride where we explore the boundaries (or lack thereof) on Zwift.
The ride will begin with 30 minutes at 3 w/kg, utilizing the fence to keep riders together. At the end of the 30 minutes, riders are free to do as they please:
they can stay together and explore the chosen course for the day, or they can head off to the nearest mountain with friends and race it!

When the 30 minute "fenced" portion of the ride is over, we will #KnowNoBounds. Have bike, will travel.
If needed, you will be able to turn to ride in opposite direction on the circuit to reconnect with the group quicker (if you need restroom or are dropped),
and most importantly, the group is not limited to the in-game courses. We can choose to go up a mountain, along a riverside, or any road we want to!

We’re on a mission: to set everyday cyclists free to explore without limits. And we’re going by bike.

Community and camaraderie in cycling is everything: group chat on this ride is highly encouraged!

name: HCT Unleashed : Sunday Service
description:
Welcome to HCT Unleashed: Sunday Service.

The week is almost over. Have you paid your dues to the Cycling Gods? This is your final chance to empty the tank and find redemption in a short, sharp Sunday evening sufferfest.

The format is a chaotic mass start, with all categories unleashed at once. But here's the twist: while you can work with—or against—anyone on the course, your official results are only against riders in your own category.

Use the bunch to your advantage. Bridge a gap with a stronger rider or launch a late attack. It’s all part of the game. Join us every week for 20-40 minutes of tactical, high-octane racing.

If you like racing with HCT or are just looking for a racing community to get involved with, join the team on Zwift Power - ""Herts County Triathletes"" https://zwiftpower.com/team.php?id=19017 - and Captain Dan will be in touch to get you set up with the Discord Server. 
On the otherhand if you prefer some less intense involvement HCT also host a Z2 ride @ 3.15pm (GMT) on Saturdays. You can also join the Club on Zwift Companion App, and find us on YouTube, Facebook and Instagram.

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: PACK Run Hill Training: Alpe du Zwift
description:
This event will start on the Road to Sky route and end just 3k up the Alpe climb. There will be a 5k lead in of 0%-1% until we reach the start of the segment and then runners will set their treadmills to 8.5%-9% (depending on TM limitations) and "run" an additional 3km. The average pace to begin will be 10kph, but at 8.5%, it will quickly drop to around 8kph. Each week, there will be an after party, where you can test your ability to get closer and closer to the top. Ultimately, we are preparing you to reach the top, but in order to do that you must transverse the Alpe - 12.2km (7.6 miles) long with over 1,000 meters of elevation gain (approx 3,400 feet) at an average gradient of 8.5%.

This may sound like a daunting task, but that's why we are here. We want to support you in your journey to the top.

If you'd like Zwift to record your elevation, you will either need a treadmill that connects directly to zwift, Runn Smart Treadmill Sensor by North Pole Engineering, or an app like Runcline.

name: RollCo: Night Shift
description:
Night Shift is Rolling Collectives after-hours ritual race.

When the lights drop and the noise fades, this is where racing gets raw. Short, sharp courses. Mixed terrain.  No hiding behind long climbs or safe pacing. From the first pedal stroke, it’s on.
Night Shift is built for riders who race on feel and instinct. Attacks come hard, selections happen fast, and hesitation costs you. You don’t wait for the race to start, you make it.

This is late-night racing for those who like it intense, imperfect and alive. All in, after dark.

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: Sunday Funday p/b TBR
description:
Come hang with some friendly peeps on TBR’s D-friendly ride! We roll together in a big, happy bunch at an average 2.0w/kg pace.

We don’t use the fence in favor of control and respect for the ride leader and listed pace. Our rides are fence free and whinge free, if you stick to the leader’s Yellow Beacon like a bear to honey you will enjoy the benefits of a group draft along with lots of friendly banter. We want you to have a happy spin on the bike!

We may be The Big Ring and known for powerful riders, but our tent is also big and we encourage riders comfortable at a social pace to meet our friendly crew and learn about the TBR Effect. We are all about supporting riders in a friendly environment and helping people feel comfortable gradually working up to a faster pace. At TBR, we love to help riders look inside themselves and discover the hidden power within.

Follow The Big Ring (TBR) at www.thebigring.cc

name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
Everyone is welcome to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round in our Sunday social ride.
Our social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubberband so
we can be one big, joyful bunch cruising the roads where everyone belongs. No
surges, no stress, no getting left behind.
If the leader isn’t using the rubberband, they will let you know, but they’ll aim to
maintain a social pace. You can check the event details to see if this is the case for
this ride by using the link 'Toggle Event Details' at the end of the event description on
zwift.com.
Ride leaders may have quizzes or other fun stuff planned for you, so please do get
involved using the companion app chat function.
Our rides are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always
respectful. Ride chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open
heart and open mind. If you want to enjoy a relaxed ride with an amazing community,
this is your space. Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.
If you want to learn more about what to expect on one of our rides, or find links to our
Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: WMZ Bonjour Recovery & Optional Sprints (p/b Champion Systems)
description:
Waratah Masters is a cycling club based in Sydney Australia. This is a recovery ride from any long weekend rides and racing, this ride includes an optional sprint segment each lap (approx every 7 minutes). It is expected everyone will stay together during the ride: no flyers. 

The ride and Leader (Yellow Beacon) averages w/kg is 1.9. 

If sprinting, please fall back to the yellow beacon after the sprint.  Bigger group = more inclusive and faster sprint times.

As well as the Zwift sprint time leaderboard the ride leader will announce the most powerful riders, so come test yourself just for fun.

The ride is a chance for weekend recovery, a friendly chat and a chance to see how much power you can put down if sprinting, or just watch others dropping watt bombs while you take it easy.

Note: on rare occasions this event may be cancelled for a given week, usually due to Australian public holidays (leader availability).

eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to Japan eSports Tempting Team Monday Morning Ride !!
Power : ave 2.5w/kg〜3.0w/kg
Of course, ZWIFTer of all countries can participate. Leaders and heads pull groups at 2.5~3.0w/kg. Riders who are hard at the above power should try grouping by using drafting well.
If you leave the group behind, please offer with ""HELP !!"" and ZWIFT CAHT. Sweeper goes for support. Sweeper will not go for support unless he offers ""HELP !!"". Also, please offer within 10 seconds of time difference as much as possible.

Rule of this group ride
· You always keep grouping in mind( this is not a race )
· Do not Lead from Leader - yellow beacon
· Power Ups allowed ( do not use final Sprint )
· TT Bike allowed
Follow the leader's instructions, let's work together and make the best group, the best workout!

JETT Monday Morning Ride
パワー ave.2.5w/kg〜3.0w/kg
Japan Monday Morning Ride! もちろん、全ての国のZWIFTerが参加できます。 リーダーおよび先頭は2.5〜3.0w/kgでグループを引っ張ります。上記のパワーでは辛いというライダーはドラフティングをうまく活用してグルーピングにトライして下さい。
もし、集団から後方に離れてしまった場合、「HELP!!」とZWIFT CAHTで申し出てください。Sweeperが支援に向かいます。「HELP!!」の申し出がない限り、Sweeperは支援には行きません。また、可能な限りタイム差１０秒以内に申し出をお願いします。
このグループライドのルール
・常にグルーピングを心がけること(レースではありません）
・リーダーの黄色いビーコンよりも前に出ないこと（２０m以上）
・TT Bike OK
・スプリントはリーダー指示に従いましょう
50分のGroup Ride、リーダー指示に従い、みんなで協力して最高のグループ、最高のワークアウトにしましょう！

name: Ascenders Team Asia Morning Group Run
description:
Come and join the Ascenders Team as we put on our running shoes and run
daily with our friends too by starting our day in a healthy way. Research
shows that just 30 minutes of running can have huge benefits on your
short-term and long-term health. So we designed our running events to
motivate athletes to run 30 minutes each day to boost your metabolism and
use those calories. Running will also help you look good and feel stronger.

Our group run is designed with runners of all levels in mind and set the
pace range to be determined by our Zwifter Runners. So find a group pace
that matches how you feel each day and make those steps count for you.
Runners who went beyond the event duration will find that we have selected
courses that will help you earn the Route Badges when you run the full
distance.

So lace up those running shoes as everybody is welcome to join with our
friendly and motivating runners.

# Join Ascenders Team on Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/AscendersZwift
# Ascenders Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/cBfQ5jkrPh

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Neokyo Crit Course
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

description:
Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

https://www.facebook.com/groups/1223724692417314/

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

name: FRR Weekend Warrior Series - SCRATCH
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: ZLDR AYOP Event
description:
Start your day on the right foot or the left. Come to our 5k at your own pace (AYOP). Run, walk, chat, laugh and get your day moving on a positive note! Attitude is 90% of any situation so let’s make this day the best day and get you in the best mindset so you can be the best you!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

For more ZLDR fun and support, join our groups on social media platforms:

Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZLDR2020

name: OTR Tempo Group Ride
description:
Come join OTR for our weekly Tempo Group Ride. Courses will rotate weekly on shorter circuit routes so slower riders off the back have a chance to rejoin the group. The Yellow Beacon ride leaders will guide you through a mix of sprints, tempo, and recovery laps. Be careful, the fence is live and will zap you if you fly off the front! The final lap is an optional race pace lap and a chance to give it all you got!

B group will focus on riding together at an average pace between 2.8 - 3.2 w/kg.
D group will focus on riding together at an average pace between 1.8 - 2.2 w/kg.

Join us for some conversation during the ride on our OTR discord channel at: https://discord.gg/WjY7EuAMv4

If you are interested in racing with OTR please reach out to any OTR team member. We are happy to help you meet your racing goals!

name: Bikealicious Awesome Rides
description:
We are a friendly gathering of cycling enthusiasts. We ride for 60 minutes and throw some badge hunt here and there. Bikealicious assigns new routes every Sunday (EST)/Monday (UTC) to keep the workout fresh and fun for all the shifters. We ride with a rubber band to motivate all skill sets to stay together through challenging routes, resulting in an interactive and dynamic workout. Our group includes riders of all power levels. We welcome all riders.

Don’t forget to check you’re using the fastest bike frame and wheels available to you!

name: 3R VOLT Interval Ride [~2.6-3.2 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. 3R VOLT runs five days a week and is designed to provide a solid and fun training platform for riders.

Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.8-3.2 w/kg.

The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides and training needs, the following is a typical week:
Monday – After what has hopefully been a fun backed weekend on the bike, this our recovery session
Tuesday – Tends to be more of a classic interval session, riders usually finish with an average of around 3.0w/kg
Wednesday – We take to the hills and one of our tougher sessions with riders averaging around 3.2w/kg
Thursday – is our no red beacon ride and again tough interval sets and riders finishing around 3.2w/kg
Friday - is a little different, we don't take ourselves too seriously and often play a variety of games and quizzes along side the intervals and riders end up with around 2.8-3.0w/kg

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some may take up to 75mins with the majority finishing with either a ramp or a mini race.

The group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the VOLT discord server and features a friendly bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/

This group ride is not a race so. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.

name: 3R SPARK Steady State Ride [~2.0-2.2 w/kg avg]
description: This is a 3R Group Ride Event (not a race). 3R Spark runs five days a week and is designed to be an accessible and sociable training session, aimed primarily at riders in Cat-D. Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.0-2.5 W/kg. The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides. Mondays and Tuesdays are our entry-level steady-state rides, where we aim to hold a steady 2.0-2.2 throughout. Thursdays and Fridays are our interval sessions, designed to help Cat D riders push themselves a little further. For interval sessions we aim to average between 2.2-2.5 for the session, but there will be times above and below. Thursday and Friday sessions often include an optional mini-race at the end. Wednesday is the Taylor Zwift Fan Club ride, a led by the hosts of the popular podcast of the same name – expect a sociable steady-state session with lots to keep you entertained! The TZFC ride is livestreamed at twitch.tv/TaylorZwiftFC. Rides are typically around an hour long. Spark is a great introduction to group rides on Zwift, we are a friendly and supportive group who love to see one another succeed. We always have a sweeper (red beacon) whose wheel you can grab if you get dropped. There’s always plenty of good chat, via in-ride messages or on Discord. Come and join us! Join the 3R Facebook group for more info: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #3R #RideRaceRaise

name: Mountain Massif structured training:  Tempo Efforts 2
description:
Created by Matteo Cigala, from Cigala Cycling, this structured training session is designed to help you cycle at a higher intensity.  For coaching and all your training needs visit https://coaching.cigalacycling.com/trainsmarterridefaster

About the session:
This session builds aerobic readiness, controlled tempo and threshold exposure, and sustained tempo endurance. The warm up prepares the athlete for early intensity changes. The tempo and threshold blocks elevate heart rate and activate muscular engagement without creating unnecessary fatigue. The main tempo sets focus on maintaining strong, steady power while holding a smooth, efficient cadence. Recovery intervals ensure quality and repeatability across all sets. The cool down supports gradual heart-rate reduction and full metabolic clearance.
Session details:
Warm Up 
5 min 40–65% CP 100–110 rpm

1 x Tempo 
3 min 80% CP Free cadence

1 x Threshold 
1 min 95% CP Free cadence

Recovery 
5 min 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm

3 x Tempo Sets 
8 min 75–90% CP 100–110 rpm
5 min recovery between sets 50–60% CP 90–100 rpm

Cool Down 
5 min 40–55% CP 100–110 rpm

Total Time: 58 minutes

Key coaching cues:
Keep transitions between intensities smooth and controlled. Hold steady power during tempo and threshold efforts without drifting upward. Maintain relaxed upper-body posture and consistent breathing. Use recoveries to reset cadence and technique before the next block. Stay focused on smooth, efficient pedalling during the longer tempo sets. 

Safety Note: 
Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first. All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.
More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home
To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using the TrainingPeaks app or Vekta by following the link https://joinvekta.com/

name: Bikealicious Joy Ride
description:

So hop on that bike, grab those bottles, and let’s ride!

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: TBR Ride and Shine
description:
Mental Wellness and Sprints!!!
TBR Ride and Shine is a group ride at 1.8-2w/kg, with some Mental Wellness chat and optional sprint efforts and re-grouping.
Each ride there will be wellness topics of interest to hopefully promote a positive mindset with tools to fight a ferocious black dog.
We have a sweep crew so please shout out if you need some help, but this flat route should keep riders nice and tight.
We don't use the fence for this ride as we believe all riders should exercise self-control and respect the ride leader by riding with the yellow beacon at all times. Your co-operation helps us provide everyone with a fun, supportive and inclusive ride.
Follow The Big Ring (TBR) at www.thebigring.cc

WE ROLL DEEP. WE ROLL FOR BODY. WE ROLL FOR MIND. WE ROLL FOR OURSELVES. WE ROLL FOR OTHERS. WE ROLL TOGETHER. WE ROLL APART. BUT WHEN WE ROLL, WE KNOW WE’RE NEVER ALONE. Don’t forget, GET YOUR SILLY ON!

name: TOUR HISP 2026 Stage 7
description:
Tour de HISP 2026

This is HISP’s most challenging and exigent event, now in its fifth edition.

We will race 13 stages in 14 days, starting on August 24th. There will be four starts each day, so you can choose whichever fits your schedule best. You can even repeat a stage, but only your best time will count for the General Classification (GC).

Standings will be calculated by simple time addition, just like a classic stage race. Categories will be assigned according to the ZCE system.

You can find more information on the stages and schedule here: https://hispevents.com

You can find the GC (ZwiftPower) here: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=3324

***

Tour de HISP 2026

Este es el evento más exigente de HISP, nuestro mayor desafío, que llega ya a su quinta edición.

Serán trece etapas en catorce días, arrancando el 24 de agosto. Contaremos con cuatro salidas diarias para que puedas escoger la que mejor te convenga. Puedes repetir la etapa si lo deseas, pero solamente contará tu mejor tiempo para la Clasificación General (GC).

La clasificación se calculará por suma simple de tiempos, como en una carrera clásica por etapas. Las categorías se regirán por el sistema ZCE.

name: Monday Run Club
description:
Start your week off right with a group run hosted by the Zwift Runners Facebook Group. We’ll ease into another week of training alongside the community while actively recovering from any long runs you might have had during the weekend. With runs in seven time slots with four pace groups each (A being the fastest and D being the slowest), there’s an event for everyone. 

Pace Groups
A) 7.5–8.5 mph // 12–14 kph
B) 7–7.5 mph // 10.5–12 kph
C) 6–6.5 mph // 9.5–10.5 kph
D) 5–5.5 mph // 8–9 kph

We’ll be using workout mode throughout these runs so everyone can easily determine their speed. Though these runs utilize a mostly steady pace, there will be some speed changes for variety.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Run in general, then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook Group or zwift.com/run

name: ZTBR - Training Stabilization TTT
description:
Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] together with Assessoria Franklin Almeida, provides this training with a focus on providing better "Stabilization" in the performance of athletes seeking better performance in Team Time Trial (TTT) events.

This training aims to help the athlete tolerate and withstand an accumulation of substrates produced by the body in sub-maximal activities, bringing more stability and control in time-based tests.

Franklin Almeida Consulting was created in 2005, with the aim of evaluating the physiological profile, developing training to improve your physical capacity, health and maximum performance.
One of the pioneers in distance consulting in Brazil!

Note: We will have other phases of this training in addition to Stabilization, they are: (Training for FTP Gains and Terrain Variations).

===
Português:
Treino de Estabilização by Franklin Almeida

Descrição: O Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] juntamente com a Assessoria Franklin Almeida, disponibiliza este treino com foco em proporcionar melhor "Estabilização" na performance de atletas que buscam um melhor desempenho nos eventos tipo Team Time Trial (TTT).

Esse treino tem o objetivo de ajudar o atleta a tolerar e suportar um acúmulo de sustratos produzidos pelo organismo em atividades sub máximas trazendo mais estabilidade e controle em provas de conta relógio.

A Consultoria Franklin Almeida foi criada em 2005, com o objetivo de avaliar o perfil fisiológico, desenvolver treinos para melhorar sua capacidade física, sua saúde e desempenho máximo.
Um dos pioneiros em consultoria a distância no Brasil!

Obs.: Teremos outras fases deste treinamento além da Estabilização, são elas: (Treino para Ganhos de FTP e Variações de terreno).

name: Team VTO Chilltown Ride
description:
Kick off your week with Team VTO’s Chilltown Ride – a relaxed and social group ride with the option to turn up the heat on each lap!

This ride is perfect for anyone looking to ease into the week, spin out the legs, or just enjoy a good vibe with friendly riders. Not a race – but we do throw in optional sprint segments each lap for those who want a little extra effort before regrouping with the bunch.

Ride Highlights:
🚴‍♂️ Social pace with Beacon
⚡ Optional sprints each lap
🔁 Regroup after efforts
📣 Friendly banter encouraged
🚫 No sweeper – just stick with the bunch
🌟 Great for new Zwifters learning group dynamics

It’s like meeting up with your mates for a cruise and chat – just in Watopia. Whether you’re sprinting or just spinning, you’re welcome here.

Join us every Monday at 7:00PM AEST (local time adjusted) and roll into the week with Chilltown vibes! 😎

For more info on Team VTO check us out on Bookface or your Zwift Companion Club

name: DIRT 505 Monday Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Monday Endurance Ride!

Please join us weekly on Mondays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 90 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option.
The ride leader will stay as close to ride pace as possible. We try to change up the routes each week and some of the routes may include some small to moderate climbs.

Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.

name: GRIT Easy Ride
description:
The ride will begin with a warm-up around 2.5 w/kg for 5-10 minutes. After the warm-up, the beacon will increase the pace to 3.0-3.2 w/kg. Riders are asked to respect the beacon, stay with the group, and enjoy a relaxing spin. Help keep the peloton together by limiting power on hills and maintaining a moderate pace.
Optional: Use this ride to warm up for GRIT’s Micro Madness Group Workout. This HIIT-style workout immediately follows Easy Ride and can help you add a dose of intensity to your riding routine.
Embrace your inner easy and start your week with GRIT!
GRIT: Great Rides for Intense Training

eventSubgroups.name: GRIT Easy Ride (B)
eventSubgroups.description:
This is planned as a recovery ride to allow riders to ride an easy pace after some hard weekend events.

All our GRIT rides start with an easy warmup pace around 2.5 w/kg for about 10 minutes. All riders are asked to stay together during this warmup section. Please help the group by keeping the peloton together during this warmup section. Ride at an easy pace at the front to avoid riders falling off the back.

After the warmup, all riders are asked to ride at 3.0 w/kg. This is an easy ride to help with recovery from weekend events. Please help us keep the group together at this easy pace of 3.0 w/kg.
This will be a fun social event so plan to enjoy a workout with friendly riders. We will limit power on hills to keep riders together.

name: KISS at Base Training Ride
description:
Join us to work on your endurance and power output at your aerobic threshold (AT) in Zone 2. The exercise will give you endurance and increased performance using fat as energy. A well-developed AT can give you better race performance increase the amount of time before your body uses glycogen stores.

We are now offering four separate paced rides to better accommodate various fitness levels. 
The A cat is for riders with zone 2 higher than 3.99
The B cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 3.2 - 3.99 w/kg. 
The C cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.5 - 3.19 w/kg.
The D cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.0 - 2.5 w/kg.

Remember this when you approach hills and inclines along the way. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) and the sweeper beacon (red) to stay in the blob.

So turn on your graph (press G on computer keyboard or select it from on-screen menu in iOS and Android) and paint it blue. Give the body a good foundation for Zwift racing. Discord server Link: https://discord.gg/kBmXhY2

name: The HERD M2C2
description:
JOIN THE MONDAY MORNING COFFEE CREW!

New to Zwift? Raced hard over the weekend? Just need reason to get moving on a Monday? Join The Herd for the most chill ride on Zwift served with coffee (virtual, of course). This ride is the perfect place to start if you want to become a stronger rider and gain the knowledge and confidence to try other group rides and even the races or tours that fill the Zwift Events calendar. 

Respect the leader's pace and ride with the yellow beacon. This is NOT A RACE! Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back.

Join us on Discord during the ride to participate in audio conversation with one another. It will help the time pass by and give you a space to ask all the questions you have about Zwift and Cycling in general: https://discord.gg/HSrx2Cz6wu

name: CRYO-GEN Wheelie Fun Recovery Ride
description:
Join CRYO-GEN for a recovery spin designed to wake the legs up, flush them out, and leave you feeling better than when you started.

We’ll stay mostly in the gray zone with a cadence of 80+ rpm. On small inclines, please go sub 2. Remember to gear down, and spin up to keep the effort light. The focus is on a smooth pedal stroke, good form, and steady blood flow to support recovery. The red beacon will roll at a more relaxed pace if needed.

This is a social, supportive ride where the goal isn’t speed — it’s recovery.

There are no sweepers on this ride so everyone can stay comfortably in their own recovery zone. This is your ride — spin easy, chat, and do what works for you, as long as you’re truly recovering.

Think of this as the perfect reset to get you ready for your next workout, race, or climb.

Come spin the legs and start the week feeling good. 🚴‍♀️

HEALTH: We would advise any rider who is attempting a Zwift ride for the first time to ensure that their health should always take precedence over completing any ride. If you feel unwell or unable to continue please STOP

NOTE: Exercise contributes to 25% weight loss; Healthy Eating (Not Diet) contributes to the other 75%. Be fit and Healthy.

name: Epictour - Structured Workout
description:
#Startyourweek with Epictour!

This is a short and intense ride! Our ride leader, Josh, will lead you through a 45min interval workout, with intervals at over your FTP value between 105% and 120%. Rubberband is in effect so that no matter how many watts you push, everyone will stick together. 

We are a friendly and welcoming bunch that like to work hard - if you've never ridden an Epictour ride, today is great day to start! 

This event is recurring. Same time next week with a new workout! 

Notes: 

- You will default to ERG mode.  If you prefer your smart trainer to not auto adjust resistance, deselect ERG in the menu before the ride to bring you to SIM mode ( https://support.zwift.com/en_us/erg-mode-in-workouts-SkQJC8OEH )

- The displayed peloton speed will be slower than anticipated. This will not affect your workout, but it is a quirky feature.

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/QK9vVdFjUJ

If you have questions about tech set-up for zwift or cycling in general, please feel free to message us on our social platforms, we would be happy to help you where we can!

https://www.instagram.com/epictourgranfondo/
https://www.facebook.com/Epictourgranfondo
https://www.strava.com/clubs/epic-tour

Epictour is a cyclist-first company from Toronto, Canada, producing events, training programs and offering high-quality products. Our signature event is Epictour, the GTA's Granfondo. Sept 12 2021.
www.epictour.ca/check-us-out

name: DWGZ — Cafecito
description:
DWGZ — Cafecito

Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. Many of us have zwifted together for years, and some have taken those virtual connections IRL, organizing meetups around the world. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build community, emotional endurance, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Cafecito — coffee and community, Spanish-style — is a smoother, steadier session, the perfect recovery-style spin after a big weekend of riding. Expect relaxed vibes and plenty of the trademark DWGZ banter that makes early mornings a little more fun. This is your chance to shake out the legs, reconnect with the crew, and ease into the week with good energy.

Whether you're rebuilding the engine, looking for friendly wheels to spin with, or just want to start your Monday with supportive community, you're in the right place.

Ride Categories 🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg 🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg 🚴 D Category – 2.0–2.6 w/kg

Expect consistent endurance pacing, smooth rotation, and a welcoming group from yellow beacon to sweep. Every pocket of the ride is built on teamwork, connection, and that signature DWGZ vibe.

DWGZ rides run seven days a week at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.
Clip in, sip the vibes, and roll into the week with us.

Our pace will average between 2.5-2.7, but can vary within the ride… There might be times where we hit a slightly higher pace, but we will always recover…

Bring your best banter and lazy legs and enjoy.

name: ZTBR - Training Stabilization TTT
description:
Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] together with Assessoria Franklin Almeida, provides this training with a focus on providing better "Stabilization" in the performance of athletes seeking better performance in Team Time Trial (TTT) events.

This training aims to help the athlete tolerate and withstand an accumulation of substrates produced by the body in sub-maximal activities, bringing more stability and control in time-based tests.

Franklin Almeida Consulting was created in 2005, with the aim of evaluating the physiological profile, developing training to improve your physical capacity, health and maximum performance.
One of the pioneers in distance consulting in Brazil!

Note: We will have other phases of this training in addition to Stabilization, they are: (Training for FTP Gains and Terrain Variations).

===
Português:
Treino de Estabilização by Franklin Almeida

Descrição: O Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] juntamente com a Assessoria Franklin Almeida, disponibiliza este treino com foco em proporcionar melhor "Estabilização" na performance de atletas que buscam um melhor desempenho nos eventos tipo Team Time Trial (TTT).

Esse treino tem o objetivo de ajudar o atleta a tolerar e suportar um acúmulo de sustratos produzidos pelo organismo em atividades sub máximas trazendo mais estabilidade e controle em provas de conta relógio.

A Consultoria Franklin Almeida foi criada em 2005, com o objetivo de avaliar o perfil fisiológico, desenvolver treinos para melhorar sua capacidade física, sua saúde e desempenho máximo.
Um dos pioneiros em consultoria a distância no Brasil!

Obs.: Teremos outras fases deste treinamento além da Estabilização, são elas: (Treino para Ganhos de FTP e Variações de terreno).

name: ZWC Hill Climb Battle
description:
Welcome to the Team ZWC Hill Climb Battle!
Is this a race? Yes, but it is also a highly effective workout to improve your fitness.
Boost your FTP  by going full gas on climbs and racing one another!

POWER UPs:Allowed at all times
BIKES:All allowed

GROUPS:
Use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg then pick the correct group:
A:4.0 W/kg FTP+
B:3.2 W/kg to 3.9 W/kg FTP
C:2.5 W/kg to 3.1 W/kg FTP
D:Under 2.4 W/kg FTP

Have Fun! Ride On!!


Team ZWC Hill Climb Battle

毎週月曜日に開催のヒルクライムレース!!
Zwift屈指のヒルクライムコース、Franceの「Mont Ventoux」を登るルートLa Reineを中心に
Mountain Route,Mountain 8のルートは「Epic KOM」「Epic KOM Reverse」を登りその先にある「ラジオタワー」の激坂を登った山頂ゴールになります。

世界中のZwifterと競い合うことでワークアウト以上の刺激とトレーニング効果が期待できます。

Zwifterの参加をお待ちしています。

POWER UPs:アイテム使用可能
BIKES:全ての自転車を選択可能

カテゴリーに関して
あなたのFTPを体重で割った数値をパワーウエイトレシオ【○○W/kg】となります。
例：FTP250W、体重60kgの方は4.166W/kgになりますのでAカテゴリーを選択下さい。
FTPとはサイクリストが1時間を通して維持できるパワーになります。
FTPの数値がわからない方はZwift Workout内のFTPテストで計測出来ます。

A:4.0W/kg FTP以上の方
B:3.2W/kg～3.9W/kg FTPの方
C:2.5W/kg～3.1W/kg FTPの方
D:2.4W/kg FTP以下の方

Have Fun! Ride On!!

#ZwiftJapan #ZwiftWarriorsCycling #FunisFast #zwc #japan #japanrace

eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to the Team ZWC Hill Climb Battle!
Is this a race? Yes, but it is also a highly effective workout to improve your fitness.
Boost your FTP  by going full gas on climbs and racing one another!

POWER UPs:Allowed at all times
BIKES:All allowed

GROUPS:
Use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg then pick the correct group:
A:4.0 W/kg FTP+
B:3.2 W/kg to 3.9 W/kg FTP
C:2.5 W/kg to 3.1 W/kg FTP
D:Under 2.4 W/kg FTP

Have Fun! Ride On!!


Team ZWC Hill Climb Battle

毎週月曜日に開催のヒルクライムレース!!
Zwift屈指のヒルクライムコース、Franceの「Mont Ventoux」を登るルートLa Reineを中心に
Mountain Route,Mountain 8のルートは「Epic KOM」「Epic KOM Reverse」を登りその先にある「ラジオタワー」の激坂を登った山頂ゴールになります。

世界中のZwifterと競い合うことでワークアウト以上の刺激とトレーニング効果が期待できます。

Zwifterの参加をお待ちしています。

POWER UPs:アイテム使用可能
BIKES:全ての自転車を選択可能

カテゴリーに関して
あなたのFTPを体重で割った数値をパワーウエイトレシオ【○○W/kg】となります。
例：FTP250W、体重60kgの方は4.166W/kgになりますのでAカテゴリーを選択下さい。
FTPとはサイクリストが1時間を通して維持できるパワーになります。
FTPの数値がわからない方はZwift Workout内のFTPテストで計測出来ます。

A:4.0W/kg FTP以上の方
B:3.2W/kg～3.9W/kg FTPの方
C:2.5W/kg～3.1W/kg FTPの方
D:2.4W/kg FTP以下の方

Have Fun! Ride On!!

#ZwiftJapan #ZwiftWarriorsCycling #FunisFast #zwc #japan #japanrace

name: Monday Run Club
description:
Start your week off right with a group run hosted by the Zwift Runners Facebook Group. We’ll ease into another week of training alongside the community while actively recovering from any long runs you might have had during the weekend. With runs in seven time slots with four pace groups each (A being the fastest and D being the slowest), there’s an event for everyone. 

Pace Groups
A) 7.5–8.5 mph // 12–14 kph
B) 7–7.5 mph // 10.5–12 kph
C) 6–6.5 mph // 9.5–10.5 kph
D) 5–5.5 mph // 8–9 kph

We’ll be using workout mode throughout these runs so everyone can easily determine their speed. Though these runs utilize a mostly steady pace, there will be some speed changes for variety.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Run in general, then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook Group or zwift.com/run

#gozwiftrun #mrc

name: MHG Run Club
description:
Back in January 2021, Eddie Izzard ran 32 marathons in 31 days. Our community rallied together and joined the action all month long. This inspired us to create the MHG Run Club, which continues Eddie’s incredible efforts of making humanity great.

The MHG Run Club motivates and supports everybody, whether you’re looking for tips to achieve your training goals or looking for a group to bond and socialize with. A light-minded Zwift treadmill runners group, for runners of all abilities, friendly chat and a good laugh :)

Please feel free to join me Clive Finnimore with our official MHG Run Club Lunchtime 5K @ 8KPH on Monday, Wednesday & Fridays, See you there soon :)

Please also join us on:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/252358412942586/
Strava: https://www.strava.com/clubs/MHGA
Keep on Running

description:
Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

https://www.facebook.com/groups/1223724692417314/

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

name: PAOLO BARBERA & SCANNELLATORI SERIALI WORKOUT
description:
"Scannellatori Seriali" is a large community of cyclists, triathletes, and runners. We invite you to join our community by following our Instagram page at https://www.instagram.com/scannellatori_seriali/ or contacting us on Facebook.
 
Coach Paolo Barbera (Please visit www.heycoach.it )   is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healty nutrition and tailored training programs

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

name: Epictour - Structured Workout
description:
#Startyourweek with Epictour!

This is a short and intense ride! Our ride leader, Danica, will lead you through a 45min interval workout, with intervals at over your FTP value between 105% and 120%. Rubberband is in effect so that no matter how many watts you push, everyone will stick together. 

We are a friendly and welcoming bunch that like to work hard - if you've never ridden an Epictour ride, today is great day to start! 

This event is recurring. Same time next week with a new workout! 

Notes: 

- You will default to ERG mode.  If you prefer your smart trainer to not auto adjust resistance, deselect ERG in the menu before the ride to bring you to SIM mode ( https://support.zwift.com/en_us/erg-mode-in-workouts-SkQJC8OEH ) or you can change it in game. 

- The displayed peloton speed will be slower than anticipated. This will not affect your workout, but it is a quirky feature

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/QK9vVdFjUJ

If you have questions about tech set-up for zwift or cycling in general,
please feel free to message us on our social platforms, we would be happy
to help you where we can!

https://www.instagram.com/epictourgranfondo/
https://www.facebook.com/Epictourgranfondo
https://www.strava.com/clubs/epic-tour

Epictour is a cyclist-first company from Toronto, Canada, producing events,
training programs and offering high-quality products. Our signature event is Epictour, the GTA's Granfondo. Sept 12 2021.

www.epictour.ca/check-us-out

name: Welcome to the Outback DIRT ride
description:
Righto, ya pack of legends! Time to saddle up for the DIRT Welcome to the Outback Ride—a C-grade roll that’ll sit between 2.5 and 3.2 W/kg. It’s a no-drop, good vibes only ride, so don’t go tearing off like a blue-arse fly, or you’ll be riding solo quicker than a backpacker who’s just met a drop bear.

We’ll be as fast as a mob of roos, but don’t stress—we’re here for a solid spin, not to go full gas like a bogan in a V8. Stick with the bunch, spin the legs, and enjoy the ride. If you get caught at the back, don’t panic—we’ll pull ya back in like a snag on a barbie.

This isn’t a race, so save the “I reckon I can hold 5 W/kg for an hour” for another day, champ. We’re here to ride, yarn, and maybe even throw in a “that’s not a ride… THIS is a ride” for good measure.

So slap on ya best Zwift kit (or if you’re feeling brave, your finest budgie smugglers), fill up ya bidons, and let’s get flat out like a lizard drinking. See ya on the start line, ya flamin’ legends!

name: CHINA ZCRC Spicy 100km
description:
欢迎参加CHINA ZCRC Spicy 100km，这场100公里的长距离“辣堡”活动由ZCRC和G7 Cycling Club联名举办。

每周一的晚上，和小伙伴们一起相约进行一场100公里的长距离有氧训练，并且在最后的几公里来进行一场势均力敌的对决吧！

为了保证竞赛的公平性，请确保你已经正确校准了你的功率计，正确设置你的身高、体重和性别，佩戴心率带，否则你将可能被取消最终的比赛成绩并且被拉入黑名单。

同时，请确保你的能力符合你参加的比赛组别，我们一般以基于FTP的功率体重比来衡量车手的组别：

# A组水平要求：无限制

# B组水平要求：不得大于4.0w/kg

# C组水平要求：不得大于3.2w/kg

欢迎关注我们ZCRC的其他公开活动并且参与其中：

每周一 /北京时间 晚上19:05：
CHINA ZCRC Spicy 100km

每周三 /北京时间 晚上20:05：
CHINA ZCRC Group Training Ride

每周五 /北京时间 晚上20:00：
CHINA ZCRC Friday Indoor Race

每周六 /北京时间 晚上19:30：
CHINA ZCRC Winter Challenge Series

*欢迎你关注并且加入我们的其他社交平台和媒体：

*QQ群: 626918793
*微信群: hzw-hzw-hzw
*新浪微博: ZWIFT_CHINA
*Instagram: ZWIFT_CHINA

Welcome to CHINA ZCRC Spicy 100km, this ride is brought to you by ZCRC and G7 Cycling Club from China. 

Spicy 100K is a new different challenge for you to build up capacity of endurance and tempo, so you will keep most time of blur or green graph in this ride. Keep drafting and stay together for the first 95km and the last 5km will be a tough race to boost your full power.

The peloton will stay together for a steady pace on 3.2-3.6w/kg (230watts-250watts).

This is a public race so we warmly welcome zwifters from all over the world to participate in the race. Please calibrate your power meter and wear HRM for the fair. Keep smiling, keep attacking, keep handsome, we will live broadcast every race.

Make sure the group which you choose matches your power or you will be DQed:

# Group A: Unlimited

# Group B: No more than 4.0w/kg

# Group C: No more than 3.2w/kg

Following ZWIFT events about G7 Cycling Club:

# CHINA ZCRC Spicy 100km
(Monday 11:05 UTC)

# CHINA ZCRC Group Training Ride
(Wednesday 12:00 UTC)

# CHINA ZCRC Friday Indoor Race

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The Monthly GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: https://www.zwift.com/racing/leagues/zracingaug2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724
WOMEN'S EVENTS = Dedicated women's races available throughout the series.

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter

Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Zwift TT Club Racing - Castle to Castle
description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

Come join Zwift TT Club on Zwift for more Time Trial event information! https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b3d1a903-df49-44eb-9c6f-4ba9f0622efe/home

Join us as we embark on a series of events - each week you will have multiple chances to set your best time on the same route!

Over the course of the series, we’ll be using routes in the region of 15-25km.

Check out Zwiftpower.com after your event to see how well you stack up against the competition!

Don’t forget to check you’re using the fastest bike frame and wheels available to you!

name: JETT Base Ride (2.7~3.8w/kg)
description:

 Power :
B group- ave 3.3w/kg～3.9w/kg  
C group- ave.2.7w/kg～3.2w/kg
JETT Base Ride! Of course, ZWIFTer of all countries can participate. Leaders and heads pull groups at 3.3〜3.8w/kg. Riders who are hard at the above power should try grouping by using drafting well. 
If you leave the group behind, please offer with "HELP !!" and ZWIFT CAHT. Sweeper goes for support. Sweeper will not go for support unless he offers "HELP !!". Also, please offer within 10 seconds of time difference as much as possible.

· You always keep grouping in mind( this is not a race )
· Do not Lead from Leader - yellow beacon 
· Power Ups allowed ( do not use final Sprint )
· TT Bike allowed 
· Sprint is the last lap. (Do not sprint other than the last lap)

description:

name: SROZ's No Watt Left Behind
description:
Welcome to the ride where fitness is irrelevant and physics is a lie.

Thanks to Zwift’s magical rubber band, we are all bound together in mandatory, artificial harmony.

Whether you’re pushing 5 W/kg or barely stirring your coffee while spinning at 40 Watts, congratulations: you’re staying with the group.

The Rules of Engagement:
The band keeps us together, but if you drop to 0 Watts, you become an anchor dragging the entire group into the abyss. Keep the legs moving.

Flyers Will Be Teleported:
Try to break away all you want. The algorithm will simply drag you back like a leash on an unruly puppy.

Heroics Are Pointless:
Save the sprint for a ride where the game actually lets you leave people behind. Today, we suffer at the exact same virtual coordinate.

Spin easy, chat in the comments, and remember to pay it forward!

name: Endure IQ Training Squad Session
description:
SESSION FOCUS:
The focus of this session is on building your tolerance to intensities similar to those during a 70.3 triathlon. You will be working in the L3b training zone. You should hope to see reduced HR drift within this zone as you complete more of these sessions. From a physiological perspective, these sessions help promote fat oxidation, and structural changes at a muscular level, such as increased mitochondrial content and capillarization.

WARM-UP:
15 min
PREP:
5 x 30'' L4 /30' L1
2 min recovery
MAIN SET:
4 x 10 min working around 70.3 pace (2 min up and 2 min under)
5' between sets
COOLDOWN:
10 min

name: Epictour - Structured Workout
description:
#Startyourweek with Epictour!

This is a short and intense ride! Our ride leader, Keri, will lead you through a 45min interval workout, with intervals at over your FTP value between 105% and 120%. Rubberband is in effect so that no matter how many watts you push, everyone will stick together. 

We are a friendly and welcoming bunch that like to work hard - if you've never ridden an Epictour ride, today is great day to start! 

This event is recurring. Same time next week with a new workout! 

Notes: 

- You will default to ERG mode.  If you prefer your smart trainer to not auto adjust resistance, deselect ERG in the menu before the ride to bring you to SIM mode ( https://support.zwift.com/en_us/erg-mode-in-workouts-SkQJC8OEH ), or you can do it in game. 

- The displayed peloton speed will be slower than anticipated. This will not affect your workout, but it is a quirky feature

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/QK9vVdFjUJ

If you have questions about tech set-up for zwift or cycling in general,
please feel free to message us on our social platforms, we would be happy
to help you where we can!

training programs and offering high-quality products. Our signature event is Epictour, the GTA's Granfondo. Sept 12 2021.

name: ZZRC Espresso 2-2.5 Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Espresso 2-2.5wkg . This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2-2.5 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be 2-2.5 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on discord
<https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX>
Join the ZZRC Discord Server!<https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX>
discord.gg<https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX>
[favicon.ico]<https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX>


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: Zwift Epic Race - Makuri Pretzel
description:
Join us as we take on some slightly more challenging race routes!

For more Epic Races, please join the club on the Companion App: https://www.zwift.com/clubs/a1ea0324-7f4a-46a7-8547-a7a3246e349b/home

name: USMeS - Roll Call (D) 1.8 - 2.2w/kg
description:
"Welcome to USMeS Roll Call 1.8 – 2.2

Whether you’re coming off a hard weekend or easing into the week, Roll Call gets the legs turning and the mind focused without unnecessary stress. This ride is about showing up, settling in, and riding together.
✅ Pace: an average of 1.8–2.2 w/kg

name: Escape Collective Monday Meander
description:
Welcome to the Escape Collective Monday Meander group ride, brought to you by friends of the Escape Collective (escapecollective.cc).

This is a fun social group ride with the aim of enjoying riding in the bunch and having a bit of banter all with a touch of (optional) friendly competition.

Ride with our playlist, just search for “Escape Collective Zwift Playlist” on Spotify. Hit Play as the ride starts and enjoy the tunes.

Come along and ride with the crew where our ride leader will set a pace of up to 2.5w/kg after a slower warmup. Our course varies each week and most weeks will be a flat route to help keep the bunch together.
This is a social group ride not a race, so please respect the pace set by the ride leader. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) to stay in the blob - flat, hilly or in between!

Our final 15 minutes will be an optional race to the end. Start is *behind* the yellow beacon, who will call the start! Yellow beacon will maintain 2.5 w/kg until the end of the ride.

Join our Zwift club to keep in touch with upcoming rides, chat with other participants outside the ride time, or if you'd like to get involved in running the ride! Search for "Friends of Escape Collective" in Zwift Companion's clubs interface.

name: Ascenders Recovery & Slo Roll Monday
description:
You can now choose to have a useful recovery session to get your form back after a tiring week of adventure or ride with our Slo Roll Team for a very casually relaxed ride with the friendly bunch. In between both categories, riders can chat and socially interact with one another at the same time through the in-ride chats.

Category C: Avg 1.7 w/kg to 1.8 w/kg for an hour
Our Recovery Ride is typically capped our power levels around 55% of Functional Threshold Power (FTP) for a quality recovery ride. We also recommend riders to try sustain a constant and smooth cadence rate in between 85 rpm to 90 rpm for the first 50 minutes before we bring it down to 75rpm to 80 rpm for the final 10 minutes. This is designed to help you optimise your recovery form and get ready for your next ride.

Category D: 24.1 kph/15mph (Constant)
Our Slo Roll ride is designed and aimed at new riders to allow them to build confidence on the bike and on Zwift. The Slo Roll also provides the opportunity to ride at a consitently lower pace together as team.

Join the Ascenders which has the rider's well-being at our heart to start the week right. Sign up be part of our Ascenders FB group (https://www.facebook.com/groups/AscendersZwiftOpens a new window)

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649

Heart Rate Monitor

B) 7–7.5 mph // 10.5–12 kph

name: MAAP In The Field: USA Group Ride
description:
Join the MAAP crew each week, we’ll roll as a group at a moderate 2-2.5 w/kg pace. The course varies each week, with a range of undulating routes. Join our global community for a social ride and unlock the exclusive MAAP kit. Jump on the chat, ask us any questions you might have and remember that this isn’t a race, save that for Wednesdays!


How do I unlock the Off The MAAP Kit?


Not only will you be repping the kit in-event, but finish any of our weekly rides to unlock the Off The MAAP Kit in your garage, so you can proudly wear the M-Flag design on any ride.

About MAAP:

MAAP exists for the progression of cycling. An independent brand, we’re committed to bringing a new perspective on performance cycling apparel. Every piece that we design evokes our obsession with quality, function, and precision. Fabrics are hand-selected from premier Swiss and Italian mills and are constructed at the most respected factories across Europe. Using the feedback and support from racing teams and cyclists around the globe, our industry-leading product developers are relentlessly refining and evolving every product, season after season. name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: DBR Chase Race
description:
Welcome to the DBR Chase Race.

This race is all about teamwork within your category. Your goal is to work together to outpace the other categories and be the first to reach the finish line. Riders will need to use drafting and group tactics to catch the category that started ahead, while at the same time defending against the categories that started behind.

The race uses staggered starts. The lowest category starts first, followed by D, C, B, and finally A. Can your category hold off the chasers all the way to the finish line?

Rules 
A smart trainer or power meter is required. 
zPower is not allowed. 
Heart rate monitors are mandatory for all categories.
 Time trial bikes are not permitted.

To appear in the official results, you must have a registered account on ZwiftPower.com and accept their terms and conditions.

Additional information
 Race organizers may request dual recording or a matching real-life effort uploaded to Strava in order to verify a Zwift race effort. Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. 
Repeated failure to provide verification on three occasions may result in exclusion from future events until valid data is provided.
Race organizers reserve the right to exclude riders from the results due to poor sportsmanship. This includes, but is not limited to, inappropriate language, sandbagging, or other disruptive behavior.

name: Ride Club Finland: Category Spotlight
description:
Welcome to weekly Category Spotlight races brought to you by Ride Club Finland.

You'll see only riders from your own pace category:

A/A+ experiences pure elite racing without the safety net of (s)lower category riders. Every move matters when you know that all other riders are capable of responding to your attacks.

B gets authentic racing without A riders disappearing into the horizon and the temptation to follow at an unsustainable pace. Instead, you must learn your true competitors' strengths and weaknesses to succeed.

C builds confidence without much stronger riders messing up the race dynamics. In these races, you initiate attacks and control race situations until the winner is decided by crossing the finish line.

D experiences the full spectrum of racing - from early attacks to final sprints. The winner is determined by pure racing ability against equally matched competitors, not by drafting behind stronger category riders for the longest.

Your category. Your chance.
